About Pplwise
 pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.
 About our client: Filics
 Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.
 About The Role
 This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.
Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.
The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end : requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale , not just in the lab.
 What You’ll Do
 Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible
 Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level
 Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification
 Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package
 Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production
 Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training
 Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility
 About You
 Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control)
 A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product
 Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar)
 Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering
 Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification
 An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept
 Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus
 Basic experience with Linux and embedded software
 You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures
 What Filics Offers
 Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production
 Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design
 A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines
 Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company
 An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly
 Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

- Grundkenntnisse in C/C++, Buskommunikation und Softwaretest vorteilhaft
- Führerschein Klasse B und Interesse an Fahrzeugtechnologie
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Are you ready to revolutionize the fitness and health industry and contribute to a healthier society? Do you want to enhance our EGYM hardware products? Join our Electrical Engineering team in Munich as an Electrical Engineer - Electric Drive Systems & Control (m/f/d). You define and establish drive system control development as a new discipline at EGYM, build up excellence in power electronics simulation, and see your ideas directly shape our future hardware solutions. Apply now and be part of our innovative journey!
 Your daily workout
 Motor Control Development: You develop, adapt, and optimize control algorithms for electric drive systems including three-phase AC inverters and motors, with a strong focus on control performance, robustness, and cost efficiency. Collaborating with your Firmware team counterpart, you will hold joint accountability for the end-to-end management of this discipline
 System Modeling & Simulation: You build and maintain control-oriented models of electric drive systems and related components to analyze, validate, and optimize system performance, using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink or PLECS
 Validation & Testing: You support the commissioning, validation, and optimization of drive systems in the lab, using HIL setups and motor test benches to compare simulation results with measurements and improve control concepts and overall system design with our end customer in mind
 Control-Oriented Hardware Development: You contribute to the electrical design and development of drive-related hardware, bringing in your strong hardware background while ensuring controllability, measurability, and system feasibility
 Collaboration & Documentation: You work closely with Electrical, Firmware and Mechanical Engineering teams, document your technical work transparently, and manage your tasks and project timelines in a structured way.
 Your fitness level
 Electrical Engineering Studies: You have a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or an equivalent educational background
 Professional Experience: You have at least 5 years of professional industry experience in electrical engineering, electric drive systems, power electronics, or control-oriented system development. You understand the balance between technical excellence and product goals
 Technical Skills: You have solid knowledge of electric drive systems, especially AC inverter topologies, synchronous motors, control theory, and dynamic system behavior
 Modeling & Validation: You have experience in system modeling and simulation of electrical drive systems, and you know how to use engineering tools such as MATLAB/Simulink to design, analyze, and optimize real hardware systems, enabling the Firmware team to implement the optimal control algorithm
 Further skills: You can prove knowledge of the following technologies:
 Motor control algorithms for three-phase AC machines
 Control theory and closed-loop system design
 HIL testing, real-time systems and validation methods
 Motor test stands, laboratory measurements, and correlation between simulation and hardware results
 Your training goal for your first 6 months
 System Ownership: You take ownership of one of our electric drive-related system components or functions and contribute it through a first full development cycle, from concept and modeling to validation
 Control & Modeling Impact: You build the foundation for drive system control development as a new discipline at EGYM by shaping our tool ecosystem, control concepts and associated validation methods leading into a HIL setup and AC motor test stand
 Product Understanding: You build a strong understanding of EGYM’s hardware products, drive-related system requirements, and the interaction between electronics, control, and mechanics
 Knowledge Sharing: You share your expertise in electric drive systems, control theory, modeling, and validation, and help establish best practices within the team
 Culture & Engagement: You enjoy EGYM’s lively and open working environment and actively participate in our feedback culture
 The equipment we provide
 Modern & International: Be part of an international company culture where talent and passion are valued, heard and included in the decision-making process
 Work-Life Balance: Benefit from flexible working hours, hybrid workplace model and 30 days of vacation per year
 Mentoring Program: Exchange knowledge and grow together across teams and locations through our self-organized mentoring platform
 Fit & Healthy: Train for free with EGYM Wellpass and use our in-house gym equipped with EGYM Smart Strength and Smart Flex machines
 Employee Discounts: Have access to a variety of great discounted offers, from fashion to leisure, through our employee benefits portal
 Bike Leasing: Stay active by taking advantage of our bike leasing offer for your commute or leisure activities
 Subsidized Pension: Profit from our employer-subsidized pension
 Flex Budget: Use €60 per month flexibly for public transportation and a meal subsidy
 Rooftop Terrace: Enjoy your lunch breaks or an after work drinks with your colleagues on our roof terrace when in the office
 Contact Information
 Apply now (CV, salary expectations, and earliest possible start date) and specify the job ID #1960. 
 Contact: Mehak Shahid
 For further information: https://career.egym.com
 About EGYM
 Warning regarding phishing emails: Please be aware that all official EGYM recruitment communication is sent exclusively from jobs@egym.com. If you receive a suspicious message from any other domain, please ignore it and do not share personal information if in doubt.
 EGYM is a global fitness technology leader, providing fitness and health facilities with intelligent workout solutions. EGYM makes exercising smarter and more efficient with its comprehensive suite of connected gym equipment and digital products that integrate seamlessly with 3rd-party-hard- and software. The result is a fully connected training experience that drives measurable business and health outcomes on and off the training floor.
EGYM also offers subscription-based corporate fitness- and wellness solutions built on a combination of gym-access and EGYM fitness programs that directly target costly chronic conditions and boost employee health, leading to higher productivity and well-being.
EGYM's global headquarters are in Munich, Germany, with North American offices in Denver, Colorado.
EGYM is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs, regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age or any other aspect of an individual's identity.

Job Description Summary
 The Farm Level Controls team is seeking an early-career controls engineer to contribute to the development and support of GE Vernova’s WindCONTROL plant controller. WindCONTROL coordinates wind turbines at the plant level to help meet grid-code and plant-operability requirements. In this role, you will work with experienced engineers across controls, turbine, electrical, software, and grid disciplines to translate requirements into control functions, support implementation and verification, and help improve solutions for new projects and the installed fleet. This is an opportunity to build expertise in renewable power systems and plant controls while contributing to the energy transition.
 Job Description
 Roles and Responsibilities
 Support the development and enhancement of WindCONTROL features by helping analyze requirements, define use cases, and document functional designs for capabilities such as voltage and reactive power control, frequency response, ramp-rate control, and power curtailment.
 Develop and review control logic, models, or configuration with guidance from experienced engineers; use tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and relevant programming languages to explore and implement solutions.
 Assist with simulation, integration, and verification activities. Analyze results against requirements and operating scenarios, record evidence, and raise anomalies for investigation.
 Collaborate with turbine controls, electrical and systems engineering, project teams, and service colleagues to understand interfaces, plant operability needs, and customer requirements.
 Support investigation of product or fleet issues by reviewing test results, operational data, and technical records; help identify root causes and contribute to corrective actions and product improvements.
 Prepare clear technical documentation, analyses, and presentations to communicate progress, results, and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of controller development, simulation, and test methods, including maintaining useful technical records and following engineering processes.
 Required Qualifications
 Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, or a closely related technical field from an accredited university.
 Early-career candidate with foundational knowledge of control systems, electrical engineering, or software development gained through coursework, projects, an internship/co-op, research, or relevant work experience.
 Programming or modeling experience in at least one of C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink, or IEC 61131 languages; willingness to learn additional tools and technologies.
 Fluency in English, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly in writing and in conversation.
 Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team, organize assigned work, and seek input when requirements or results are unclear.
 Desired Characteristics
 Master’s degree in controls, electrical, computer, or another relevant engineering discipline or equivalent experience. 
 Academic, project, or professional exposure to wind energy, renewable integration, electrical grids, grid codes, or power-system operation.
 Experience modeling, simulating, testing, or implementing control systems, particularly real-time or industrial controls.
 Familiarity with industrial control platforms and communication protocols such as Modbus, EGD, DNP3, OPC UA, or IEC 61850; experience with GE Mark VIe is a plus.
 Exposure to SCADA, data acquisition, or analysis of operational and test data.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, curiosity, attention to detail, and a structured approach to engineering work.
 Strong interpersonal skills and interest in contributing to a global, cross-functional team.
 Benefits Available To You
 GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. In order to meet this mission, we provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce: Our Culture | GE Vernova (gecareers.com)
 Our compensation & benefits are designed to reward high performers and help you manage your personal and family needs. We offer a robust benefits package depending on your employment status and your national requirements.
 A healthy, balanced lifestyle can mean different things to different people. We've created programs that support the way you live and work today.
 GE Vernova invests to provide opportunities to grow your career by providing a path for continued on-the-job learning and development.
 Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten
 Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Verbesserung von WindCONTROL-Funktionen durch Analyse von Anforderungen, Definition von Anwendungsfällen und Dokumentation funktionaler Designs für Funktionen wie Spannungs- und Blindleistungsregelung, Frequenzantwort, Leistungsgradientenbegrenzung (Ramp-Rate Control) und Leistungsdrosselung.
 Entwicklung und Überprüfung von Steuerungslogik, Modellen oder Konfigurationen unter Anleitung erfahrener Ingenieure; Verwendung von Werkzeugen wie MATLAB/Simulink und relevanten Programmiersprachen zur Erforschung und Implementierung von Lösungen.
 Unterstützung bei Simulations-, Integrations- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten. Analyse der Ergebnisse im Vergleich zu Anforderungen und Betriebsszenarien, Dokumentation von Nachweisen und Meldung von Anomalien zur Untersuchung.
 Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Turbinensteuerung, Elektro- und Systemtechnik, Projektteams sowie Service-Kollegen, um Schnittstellen, Anforderungen an die Anlagenbetriebsfähigkeit und Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen.
 Unterstützung bei der Untersuchung von Produkt- oder Flottenproblemen durch Überprüfung von Testergebnissen, Betriebsdaten und technischen Unterlagen; Mitwirkung bei der Identifizierung von Grundursachen und Beitrag zu Korrekturmaßnahmen und Produktverbesserungen.
 Erstellung klarer technischer Dokumentationen, Analysen und Präsentationen, um Fortschritte, Ergebnisse und Empfehlungen an interne Stakeholder zu kommunizieren.
 Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung der Steuerungsentwicklung, Simulations- und Testmethoden, einschließlich der Pflege nützlicher technischer Aufzeichnungen und der Einhaltung von Ingenieurprozessen.
 Erforderliche Qualifikationen
 Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Physik oder einem eng verwandten technischen Fachbereich von einer akkreditierten Universität.
 Berufseinsteiger mit grundlegendem Wissen in den Bereichen Steuerungssysteme, Elektrotechnik oder Softwareentwicklung, erworben durch Lehrveranstaltungen, Projekte, Praktika/Co-ops, Forschung oder relevante Berufserfahrung.
 Programmier- oder Modellerfahrung in mindestens einer der Sprachen C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink oder IEC 61131; Bereitschaft, zusätzliche Werkzeuge und Technologien zu erlernen.
 Fließende Englischkenntnisse mit der Fähigkeit, technische Informationen klar in Wort und Schrift zu kommunizieren.
 Fähigkeit zur kollaborativen Arbeit in einem multidisziplinären Team, zur Organisation der zugewiesenen Aufgaben und zur Einholung von Feedback bei unklaren Anforderungen oder Ergebnissen.
 Wünschenswerte Eigenschaften
 Master-Abschluss in Regelungstechnik, Elektro-, Computertechnik oder einer anderen relevanten Ingenieurdisziplin oder gleichwertige Erfahrung.
 Akademische, projektbezogene oder berufliche Erfahrungen mit Windenergie, Integration erneuerbarer Energien, Stromnetzen, Netzanschlussrichtlinien oder dem Betrieb von Energiesystemen.
 Erfahrung in der Modellierung, Simulation, Prüfung oder Implementierung von Steuerungssystemen, insbesondere im Bereich Echtzeit- oder Industriesteuerungen.
 Vertrautheit mit Industriesteuerungsplattformen und Kommunikationsprotokollen wie Modbus, EGD, DNP3, OPC UA oder IEC 61850; Erfahrung mit GE Mark VIe ist ein Plus.
 Erfahrung mit SCADA, Datenerfassung oder der Analyse von Betriebs- und Testdaten.
 Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und Problemlösungskompetenz, Neugier, Liebe zum Detail und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise in der Ingenieurtechnik.
 Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und Interesse daran, einen Beitrag zu einem globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Team zu leisten.
 Vorteile für Sie
 Die Mitarbeiter von GE Vernova stellen sich der Herausforderung, eine Welt zu bauen, die funktioniert. Um dieser Mission gerecht zu werden, bieten wir vielfältige, wettbewerbsfähige Leistungen zur Unterstützung unserer Belegschaft: Our Culture | GE Vernova (gecareers.com)
 Unsere Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen sind darauf ausgelegt, Leistungsträger zu belohnen und Sie bei der Bewältigung Ihrer persönlichen und familiären Bedürfnisse zu unterstützen. Wir bieten ein robustes Leistungspaket, das je nach Beschäftigungsstatus und nationalen Anforderungen variiert.
 Ein gesunder, ausgeglichener Lebensstil kann für jeden Menschen etwas anderes bedeuten. Wir haben Programme entwickelt, die die Art und Weise unterstützen, wie Sie heute leben und arbeiten.
 GE Vernova investiert in Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere voranzubringen, indem wir einen Pfad für kontinuierliches Lernen und Weiterentwicklung am Arbeitsplatz bieten.
 Additional Information
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

 Deine Aufgaben

 Durchführung von entwicklungsbezogenen Tests sowohl im Fahrzeug als auch in der Simulation sowie anschließende Auswertung

 Das bringst Du mit

 Erfahrung in der modellbasierten Funktionsentwicklung
 Teamfähigkeit und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke
 Fähigkeit, selbstständig und zielorientiert zu arbeiten
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Matlab/Simulink
 Erfahrung mit Git; praktische Kenntnisse in der Nutzung von GitLab und CI/CD sind von Vorteil
 Speziell Kenntnisse in der CAN-Kommunikation.
 Grundlegendes Wissen im Bereich funktionale Sicherheit und ISO 26262

Entwicklungsingenieur / Systemingenieur Mechatronik (m/w/d)
am Standort Hasbergen-Gaste bei Osnabrück
Seit über 140 Jahren produziert AMAZONE Hightech für die Landwirtschaft. Jeden Tag vertrauen Kunden in mehr als 70 Ländern auf AMAZONE-Maschinen, um die weltweite Nahrungsmittelversorgung zu sichern. Als innovationsgetriebenes Familienunternehmen verbinden wir Tradition mit Fortschritt und entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft der Landtechnik.
Von der ersten Idee bis zur Serienreife: In deiner Anstellung als Entwicklungsingenieur / Systemingenieur Mechatronik (m/w/d) bei AMAZONE entwickelst du intelligente mechatronische Systeme, die unsere Landmaschinen noch leistungsfähiger und effizienter machen. Mit modernen Entwicklungsmethoden, deinem technischen Know-how und kreativen Lösungsansätzen gestaltest du innovative Technologien für die Landwirtschaft von morgen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und bringst deine Ideen direkt in die Produktentwicklung ein. Möchtest du mit uns die Zukunft der Landtechnik bewegen? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!
Deine Aufgaben / Das bewegst du bei uns
- Systementwicklung: Du entwickelst innovative mechatronische Systeme von der ersten Idee über die Konzeption bis zur Serienreife und gestaltest damit die nächste Generation unserer Landmaschinen.
- Modellbasierte Entwicklung: Du konzipierst und realisierst mechatronische Lösungen mithilfe modellbasierter Entwicklungsansätze und setzt dabei MATLAB/Simulink ein.
- Regelungstechnik: Du entwickelst und optimierst Regelungsstrategien für mechatronische Systeme und sorgst für ein präzises und zuverlässiges Zusammenspiel von Hard- und Software.
- Test und Validierung: Du planst und führst Tests durch, analysierst die Ergebnisse und leitest gezielte Maßnahmen zur Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung der Systeme ab.
- Fachübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktverantwortlichen, Softwareentwicklern, Konstrukteuren und Lieferanten zusammen, um innovative technische Lösungen erfolgreich umzusetzen.
- Agile Entwicklung: Du bringst dich aktiv in unsere Entwicklungsprozesse nach Scrum ein und unterstützt das Team dabei, technische Herausforderungen effizient zu lösen.
- Prozessoptimierung: Du entwickelst unsere Methoden und Werkzeuge der modellbasierten Entwicklung kontinuierlich weiter und bringst eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung unserer Entwicklungsprozesse ein.
Deine Qualifikationen / Das bringst du mit
- Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mechatronik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
- Fachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der modellbasierten Entwicklung und bist mit MATLAB/Simulink bestens vertraut.
- Regelungstechnik: Du begeisterst dich für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Regelungssystemen und findest kreative Lösungen für komplexe technische Herausforderungen.
- Programmierkenntnisse: Du bringst Kenntnisse in Python mit und verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Hard- und Software in mechatronischen Systemen.
- Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits als Entwicklungsingenieur, Systemingenieur, Mechatronikingenieur oder in einer vergleichbaren Position an der Entwicklung technischer Systeme mitgewirkt.
- Entwicklungsmethoden: Du hast idealerweise bereits mit Scrum oder anderen agilen Entwicklungsmethoden gearbeitet und kennst die Abläufe moderner Entwicklungsprojekte.
- Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, denkst analytisch und gehst komplexe Aufgaben strukturiert und lösungsorientiert an.
- Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen, kommunizierst klar und bringst deine Ideen aktiv in gemeinsame Projekte ein.
- Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse, um dich auch mit internationalen Entwicklungspartnern und Lieferanten auszutauschen.
- Zusatzqualifikation: Ein Führerschein der Klasse T ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Deine Vorteile / Darauf kannst du dich freuen
- Attraktives Vergütungspaket
- Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
- Bis zu 36 Tage Urlaub
- Gleitzeit
- Mobiles Arbeiten
- Weiterbildung und Entwicklung (AmaTrain)
- Kurze Entscheidungswege
- Viele Gestaltungs-möglichkeiten
- E-Bike-Leasing mit BusinessBike
- Gesundheitsangebote wie z.B. Hansefit
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Bezuschusste Kantine
Dein neuer Arbeitgeber / Das ist AMAZONE
Was 1883 begonnen hat, führen wir mittlerweile in vierter Generation fort: Gemeinsam mit über 2.700 Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir innovative Landmaschinen und Technologien. Jeden Tag arbeiten wir an unseren 9 Standorten daran, die Leistungsfähigkeit und den Bedienkomfort unserer Maschinen weiter zu optimieren.
Wir leben in jeder Abteilung einen hohen Anspruch an Qualität und Weiterentwicklung. Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Kooperation und unserem gemeinschaftlichen Erfolg. Mit individuellen Karrierepfaden, dem Personalentwicklungsprogramm AmaTrain und dem starken Drang für Innovation halten wir nicht nur unser Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, sondern sichern jedem einzelnen Mitarbeitenden eine erfolgreiche Zukunft bei AMAZONE.
Deine Bewerbung / Das sind die nächsten Schritte
Bewirb dich in nur wenigen Minuten online! Nach dem Absenden deiner Bewerbung erhältst du automatisch eine Eingangsbestätigung per E-Mail. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 14 Tagen mit einem ersten Feedback bei dir zurück.

items.jobTitle: Analog Modeling Technical Leader (RNM, Mixed Signal Co Simulation | 9-15 Years | Bangalore)
items.jobDescription:
Meet the Team
 Cisco’s Silicon One Optics Group (S1O) designs & delivers the high-speed optical transceivers, and platforms that power Cisco's core data center networking solutions. We specialize in the design and integration of cutting-edge IM/DD optics and silicon photonic platforms that enable customers to deploy industry-leading optical technologies within data center with unprecedented speed, capacity, and reliability. Come join us and take part in shaping S1O’s ground-breaking optical solutions by designing, developing, and testing some of the most advanced pluggable, Near Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-packaged Optics (CPO) being developed in the industry.
You will be the key member of the analog modeling team working closely with digital, analog and design verification teams to provide HDL models for analog blocks supporting mixed signal IP & chip level design verification.
 Your Impact
 As a modeling engineering Leader, you will drive the development of Verilog behavioral models, design automation and validation supporting next-generation silicon photonics and optical networking products. You will work across architecture, RTL, Analog design, DFT, verification, teams to establish scalable methodologies that enable first-pass design success and predictable full-chip closure.
You will provide technical leadership in design methodology and automation while driving improvements in design quality, productivity, and time-to-market across multiple silicon programs.
In addition to providing technical leadership, you will be responsible for:
 Lead the development of reusable analog macros, leaf cells with corresponding HDL models across product generations to improve design quality, productivity, and consistency.
 Lead cross-functional technical initiatives, resolve modeling issues, schematic to model correlation, design-flow issues, and communicate methodology and execution risks to senior engineering leadership.
 Drive adoption of AI tools to enhance productivity, quality, and development speed.
 Minimum Qualification
 Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or related field with 10+ years of industry experience, or Master's degree with 8+ years, or Ph.D. with 5+ years in Analog/Mixed-Signal (AMS) modeling and verification.
 Behavioral & Real Number Modeling: Proven expertise in developing high-accuracy, event-driven behavioral models using SystemVerilog Real Number Modeling (SV-RNM / EEnet / UDN / Wreal) and Verilog-A / Verilog-AMS.

 Experience with Digital-on-Top mixed-signal design flows, Low-Power mixed-signal verification (UPF / CPF / IEEE 1801), and Mixed-Signal Static Timing Analysis (MS-STA).
 Experience delivering fast, cycle-accurate behavioral models to embedded firmware and system teams for pre-silicon validation of calibration and bring-up sequences.
 Proven ability to establish enterprise AMS modeling guidelines, mentor junior/mid-level engineers, drive EDA tool evaluations, and steer cross-functional alignment between Analog, Digital Verification, and Architecture team

items.jobTitle: Postdoctoral Position (M/F) - Optimal Design of Power Converters Using PCB-Embedded Semiconductors
items.companyName: Mitsubishi Electric R&D Centre Europe - France
items.jobDescription:
Context and project description 
 MITSUBISHI ELECTRIC is a key player in the field of power electronics, covering the entire value chain from semiconductor devices to complete systems such as HVDC converters. As a subsidiary of the Mitsubishi Electric Group, Mitsubishi Electric R&D Centre Europe (MERCE) hosts a research team specialized in Power Electronics, with a strong focus on heterogeneous integration technologies and high-efficiency, high-power-density converters. To further increase the Technology Readiness Level (TRL) and promote its integration techniques for both active and passive components, MERCE plans to develop dedicated DC/AC and DC/DC prototypes of highly-efficient and compact power converters.
 Missions 
 We are hiring a postdoctoral researcher to carry out the following tasks :
 Experimentally define the maximum performance (Power vs. Frequency) of a half-bridge topology equipped with a PCB Embedded switching cell, under hard-switching and soft-switching (ZVS) conditions.
 Develop a Matlab-based design tool to identify Pareto fronts (Volume vs. Losses) for an interleaved multiphase converter (DC/DC and DC/AC). This tool will integrate pre-existing models related to: EMC filtering (common-mode and differential-mode), PCB based Planar filtering inductors, potentially coupled.
 Design a high-power-density DC/AC converter (power range: several tens of kW at 800 V) by selecting the most relevant solution identified on the Pareto front. This stage will include the selection of power and control devices, as well as the design of electronic boards (power, control, measurement), including PCB magnetics.
 Propose innovative solutions to improve mechanical integration and improve power density, especially for critical subsystems (e.g. active common-mode filtering to mitigate the size of a passive filter). 
 Supervise the manufacturing of components by external partners and oversee the assembly of electronic boards.
 Perform experimental validation of the prototype to assess the targeted performance indicators.
 Write technical reports to ensure consistent project monitoring and documentation.
 A second research phase will extend the work towards isolated DC/DC converters for electric mobility and data center applications. 
 The results of the research activities will be eligible for publication in international conferences and 
 peer-reviewed journals.
 Candidate Profile 
 PhD in Electrical Engineering, with a strong focus on Power Electronics design.
 Previous research experience in a public research laboratory or an industrial R&D environment. 
 Strong background in Power Electronics, including DC/AC and DC/DC topologies, gate drivers, Magnetic component design and EMC filtering techniques. 
 Proven experience with Wide Band Gap semiconductor devices and their experimental implementation (design, testing, validation).
 Proficiency in scientific computing tools (Matlab) and finite element analysis (e.g. FEMM 4.2). 
 Experience in PCB layout tools such as Altium or KiCad is a plus. 
 Hands-on experience in a laboratory environment, including power equipment (power supplies, electronic loads, control units), electrical measurements instruments (oscilloscopes and probes, impedance meters, power analyser), thermal measurement techniques (thermocouples, optical fibers, calorimetry). 
 Personal Skills 
 High level of autonomy, strong organizational skills, and rigor. 
 Motivation to work in a multicultural environment. 
 Good interaction and adaptability skills. 
 Strong analytical mindset and good communication abilities. 
 Team spirit and proactive attitude. 
 Fluent English (spoken and written).
 Duration : 12 months, from May 2026 at the earliest (a 24-month extension is possible under the 
 postdoctoral contract)
 Contact : Magali BRANCHEREAU, HR Manager (jobs@fr.merce.mee.com) 
 Please send your CV and cover letter (PDF format), quoting the reference DITFT056

About the role: 
 As part of our growing Test & Integration team, you will develop simulation and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) infrastructure to support the integration and verification of our unmanned systems across Air, Land, and sea domains.
 As a Simulation & SIL Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, integrate, and maintain reliable virtual system environments. You will bring together embedded software, vehicle models, simulated sensors and actuators, and communication interfaces to enable realistic and reproducible system execution.
 You will work closely with software developers, simulation engineers, system test engineers, and test automation engineers to make these environments accessible for development and continuous automated verification.
 By providing robust and scalable simulation infrastructure, you will support Quantum Systems in delivering high-quality unmanned systems.

 Design, develop, and maintain modular SIL infrastructure that can be reused across platforms and domains.
 Integrate embedded software with vehicle, sensor, actuator, and environmental simulations, developing and adapting models using MATLAB and Simulink.
 Implement simulation adapters, software interfaces, and supporting services using C++ and Python.
 Automate the deployment, configuration, and startup of reproducible SIL environments using Docker, Linux, and version-controlled configurations.
 Integrate SIL environments into CI/CD pipelines and provide interfaces for automated testing with Robot Framework and comparable tools.
 Investigate integration and simulation issues, collaborating with development and HIL teams to support consistent behavior across virtual and physical environments.

 A degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering, robotics, or a related field, or an equivalent practical qualification.
 At least 3 years of experience in simulation, SIL infrastructure, embedded software integration, or a similar role.
 Strong C++ programming skills and practical experience with Python.
 Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for simulation model development and integration.
 A good understanding of Linux, networking, and software interfaces.
 Experience with Docker, Git, build systems, configuration management, and CI/CD pipelines, ideally GitHub Actions.
 Strong analytical and debugging skills, with a structured approach to complex integration problems.
 Experience with vehicle dynamics, sensor simulation, real-time systems, or SIL/HIL integration is a plus.
 Familiarity with Robot Framework or comparable test automation frameworks is advantageous.
 Experience in aerospace, defense, or safety-relevant development environments is a plus.
 Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
 A proactive, organized, and collaborative mindset, with the ability to manage multiple assignments.
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Why Quantum-Systems: 
 We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.
 We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. 
 We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.
 We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.
 Our benefits: 
 Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.
 Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.
 Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.
 Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.
 Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.
 Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.
 Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.
 Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.
 Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.
 About us: 
 Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.
 Our commitment: 
 We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.
 At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

Chez Decathlon, notre ambition est claire : rassembler autour du sport et rendre le bien-être accessible au plus grand nombre. 
Pour donner vie à cet objectif, nous nous appuyons sur deux forces majeures :
 Nos coéquipiers, qui sont le cœur battant de notre écosystème.
 Notre ancrage local, qui nous lie à chaque communauté sportive pour offrir des solutions uniques (produits, services et expériences).
 Pour propulser cette vision, le Digital est un levier clé.
Ton futur terrain de jeu : la Digital Sport Unit 
Véritable trait d'union entre nos marques sportives et le digital, cette équipe conçoit les solutions de demain. 
En nous rejoignant, tu auras un impact direct : tu contribueras à créer et déployer des produits, services et expériences digitales pour simplifier le quotidien de nos coéquipiers et enchanter la pratique de nos utilisateurs sportifs.
 Le Connected Locker , c'est le cœur logiciel qui fait le pont entre tous nos produits physiques (vélos, tapis, montres) et l'écosystème digital de Decathlon.
 Ton défi ?  Absorber la complexité.  Chaque produit a ses propres protocoles et spécificités hardware ; le rôle du CL est d'unifier tout cela dans une librairie  modulaire  et robuste pour que les développeurs d'applications (Decathlon HUB, Mobility..) puissent intégrer n'importe quel équipement en quelques lignes de code.
 TES MISSIONS 
 Architecture Modulaire & Design de SDK : Concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture Kotlin découplée et évolutive, permettant d'ajouter de nouveaux types de produits sans réécrire le cœur du système..
 onnectivité Hybride & IoT : Maîtriser le stack Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) sous Android (gestion des cycles de vie, scans, reconnexions, spécificités constructeurs/ROMs) pour le local, et le MQTT/REST pour la communication Cloud
 Développement d'une "Test App" :  
 Développer et maintenir une application de test dédiée (Jetpack Compose).
 Permettre aux QA de valider les fonctionnalités du SDK en isolation.
 Intégrer des outils de simulation (mocking) pour tester les cas d'erreurs hardware difficiles à reproduire en réel 
 Abstraction (L'Art du SDK Android) : Créer des API publiques simples et idiomatiques (Kotlin Coroutines / Flow) pour masquer la complexité des machines d'états hardware aux applications utilisatrices.
 STACK TECHNIQUE 
 Langage : Kotlin (100%)
 Asynchronisme : Coroutines, StateFlow / SharedFlow
 Connectivité / IoT : Android BLE Stack, MQTT (ex: Paho/HiveMQ), AWS IoT Core, REST / WebSockets
 UI (Test App) : Jetpack Compose
 Architecture & Injection : Clean Architecture, Dependency Injection (Hilt / Koin)
 Outillage / CI-CD : Gradle (Build Logic / Version Catalogs), Git, CI/CD pipelines pour publication de SDK/AAR.
 CE DONT TU AS BESOIN POUR RÉUSSIR 
 Tu es un·e expert·e Kotlin / Android avec une vraie vision "Plateforme / SDK" (tu penses bibliothèque/AAR recontextualisable avant de penser écran/UI).

 Tu as une solide expérience en architecture logicielle (Design Patterns, Modularité, Injection de dépendances).
 Tu es basé à Lille , prêt à tester ton code sur les machines de sport à 50m de ton bureau.
 Une appétence forte pour le travail en équipe et une culture du partage.
 Un intérêt pour l’impact du sport sur le développement personnel et collectif
 L’envie de rejoindre une entreprise engagée dans le Tech4Good et l’innovation responsable.
 POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? 
 Chez Decathlon, nous mettons un point d’honneur à offrir un cadre de travail épanouissant et motivant.
 Organisation de travail hybride (2 jours de télétravail par semaine);
 Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux (Mac, Windows, ou Chromebooks) ;
 Une équipe de projet locale au sein d'un réseau mondial (possibilité de carrière internationale) ;
 Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.) ;
 Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels).
 🚀 Un environnement de travail stimulant : entreprise certifiée Great Place to Work et Happy Trainees .
💰 Des avantages attractifs (après 3 mois d’ancienneté) :
 Primes mensuelles, intéressement, actionnariat
 Avantages CSE
 25% de réduction sur nos produits
 Remboursement de 50% du titre de transport & aide à la mobilité urbaine
🎯 Un accompagnement sur mesure : coaching, formations internes et externes, partage de connaissances.
⚡ Une culture du sport et du test produit : deviens ambassadeur.trice de nos innovations et rejoins nos équipes sportives internes !
 Je ne connais pas le secteur du sport, ai-je ma place chez Decathlon ? 
 Bien sûr ! Nous recherchons avant tout des personnes passionnées et motivées, que ce soit dans leur domaine d’expertise ou par le sport en général.
 DECATHLON DIGITAL  
 Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

About Us
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 Overview
 Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.
 Ideal candidate
 A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.
 Skills Required
 PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)
 Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets
 Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking
 Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets
 Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)
 Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency
 DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly
 Component selection and BOM management
 Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus
 Responsibilities:
 Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections. 
 PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints. 
 Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management. 
 Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan. 
 Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes. 
 Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed. 
 EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections. 
 Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up. 
 Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding). 
 Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions. 
 Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications. 
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Who we are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role
 We can't flight-test our way to every answer, the range time, the cost, and the sheer number of edge cases we need to cover make that impossible. Simulation is how we de-risk fast, explore the trade space before we cut metal, and understand what happens in scenarios we'd never dare fly for real. But we don't trust a model that's never been checked against reality, the sim exists to earn its way onto the range, not replace it. 
 As a Simulation Engineer on the Physical Products team, you'll build and maintain the modelling and simulation environments that let us understand how our platforms will actually behave, aerodynamically, structurally, and as part of a full engagement, before they're built, and help interpret what happens after they fly. You'll work closely with GNC, mechanical, and systems engineers, and you'll be expected to hold your models to the same standard we hold our hardware: are they good enough to trust a decision on, and how do you know. 
 The day-to-day
 Build and maintain high-fidelity simulation environments, 6-DOF vehicle dynamics, aerodynamics, structural, and/or engagement-level models, depending on where your depth sits 
 Develop Monte Carlo and sensitivity analysis capability to explore performance across the real range of conditions a platform will see, not just the nominal case 
 Work with GNC, mechanical, and systems engineers to define what needs modelling, at what fidelity, and why, simulation effort should always trace back to a real design or operational question 
 Validate models against real test and flight data, and be honest about where a model is trustworthy and where it isn't, model credibility is a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought 
 Support design trade studies across the vehicle, aerodynamic configuration, control authority, engagement geometry, structural loading, using simulation to narrow the design space quickly 
 Build tooling and infrastructure that makes simulation faster and more accessible across engineering teams, this is as much a software engineering problem as a physics one 
 Support flight and ground test campaigns, defining what to instrument and measure so test data can actually be used to validate or correct the models 
 Communicate simulation results and their limitations clearly to engineers and decision-makers who need to act on them, not just archive them 
 You should apply if you
 Have built and maintained simulation environments for a real physical system aerospace, automotive, robotics, or a similarly dynamic and safety-relevant domain 
 Understand the underlying physics well enough to know when a model is a reasonable simplification and when it isn't, flight dynamics, aerodynamics, structures, or controls, depending on your background 
 Are strong in a relevant programming/scientific computing environment (Python, MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or equivalent), and write simulation code that other engineers can actually use and trust 
 Have experience validating simulation output against real test or field data, and can reason about the gap between the two 
 Are comfortable working with uncertainty, Monte Carlo methods, sensitivity analysis, and communicating results probabilistically rather than as a single "answer" 
 Collaborate effectively across disciplines and can explain simulation results and their limitations clearly to people who aren't simulation specialists 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have
 Experience with 6-DOF flight/missile simulation specifically, or engagement-level/wargaming simulation 
 Experience with CFD, FEA, or other high-fidelity physics-based modelling tools 
 Familiarity with real-time or hardware-in-the-loop (HITL) simulation environments 
 Experience building simulation tooling or infrastructure used by a wider engineering team, not just yourself 
 Exposure to flight test or range test data analysis and model correlation 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

Job Description 
 Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Rigorous testing is what turns a promising prototype into a product our customers can trust – and what gets us from validated prototype to Alpha customer readiness to volume shipments.
 As Test Engineer, you will design and execute test plans for our power conversion systems – from functional and target-parameter verification through stability, endurance and load testing. You will build and maintain the test setups that validate our hardware and firmware, and work closely with Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical engineers to track down and resolve issues.
 It is a unique opportunity to shape the test strategy of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Design and execute test plans for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems – functional tests, stability tests, endurance (soak) tests, and load tests.
 • Build and maintain test setups for prototype, pilot and production units, including medium-voltage test benches.
 • Support prototype validation and target-parameter verification (form factor, efficiency, stability) for our Prototype milestone.
 • Support qualification testing for Alpha customer deployments – full target-parameter verification, certification test support, and release tests for volume delivery.
 • Develop test automation scripts and tools to increase test coverage and reduce manual test effort.
 • Collaborate with the Power Electronics, Firmware, EMC/Compliance and Mechanical teams to diagnose and root-cause test failures.
 • Document test procedures, results and reports; maintain traceability for certification and quality purposes.
 • Support the definition and specification of end-of-line (EOL) test equipment for volume production, working with our EOL test equipment vendor.
 • Support field testing and diagnostics for units deployed at customer sites as needed.
 Qualifications 
 • BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, electronics engineer (Elektroniker EFZ), automation engineer (Automatiker EFZ) or comparable education.
 • 3+ years of experience in test engineering, ideally for power electronics or medium-voltage systems.
 • Experience with medium-voltage high-power test setups and lab safety protocols and practices.
 • Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g. Python, LabVIEW or similar).
 • Understanding of power electronics test methods (efficiency, thermal, load and stability testing).
 • Strong documentation and analytical skills.
 • Team player, comfortable working hands-on in the lab with cross-functional teams.
 • Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.
 • The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.
 Benefits 
 • Equity + competitive salary.
 • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.
 • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

items.jobTitle: Entwicklungsingenieur (m/w/d) für die Modellierung und Simulation von Lenkflugkörpern
items.jobDescription:
### Das sind Ihre Aufgaben:
- Sie gestalten in einem interdisziplinären Team die Simulation komplexer dynamischer Systeme der Luftverteidigung.
- Zu diesem Zweck leiten Sie mathematische Beschreibungen des physikalischen Verhaltens von Teilkomponenten der Systeme her, setzen diese in Simulationsmodellen um und validieren sie.
- Diese Modelle integrieren Sie neben taktischen Algorithmen in eine Gesamtsimulation.
- Darauf aufbauend führen Sie Simulationen auf Rechenclustern durch und bewerten die Ergebnisse im Hinblick auf die Systemperformance.
- Die Unterstützung bei der Konzeptionierung und dem Aufbau von Simulationsframeworks rundet ihr vielfältiges Tätigkeitspektrum ab.
### Das bringen Sie mit:
- Die Grundlage ist Ihr abgeschlossenes Universitätsstudium des Maschinenbaus, der Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, der technischen Kybernetik, der Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren natur- oder ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Fachrichtung, vorzugsweise mit Promotion.
- Sie begeistern sich für technische Systeme und können einschlägige Berufserfahrung vorweisen.
- Entsprechend verfügen Sie über vertiefte Kenntnisse der Methoden zur Modellbildung und Simulation, sind vertraut mit der Entwicklung von Simulationsframeworks und verfügen über Programmiererfahrung in MATLAB/Simulink sowie einer weiteren Programmiersprache, beispielsweise C++ oder Python.
- Moderne Verfahren der Softwareentwicklung sind Ihnen geläufig, Sie beherrschen die gängigen Werkzeuge, wie zum Beispiel Git, Docker, SonarQube oder Jenkins, und fühlen sich unter Linux sicher.

Vier Länder. Ein See. Die Alpen vor der Haustür. Das ist unsere Bodensee-Region: ein breites Freizeitangebot im Sommer wie im Winter sowie starke Industrien mit Weltmarktführern.

Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.de) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft - genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
Das Fraunhofer FHR in Wachtberg bei Bonn ist Teil der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft und eines der führenden und größten europäischen Forschungsinstitute auf dem Gebiet der Hochfrequenzphysik und Radartechnik.
Der Bereich „Radar zu Weltraumlageerfassung" (RWL) entwickelt vor dem Hintergrund der zunehmenden Bedrohung von Satelliten Radarsysteme und Verfahren Weltraumlageerfassung. In zwei Abteilungen vereinen sich unsere Expertisen in den Teilbereichen Radararchitekturen und Verfahren zur Weltraumbeobachtung, als auch Radarsysteme und operationeller Betrieb. Zur Unterstützung der Arbeiten betreibt der Bereich mit dem TIRA (Tracking and Imaging Radar) eine der weltweit leistungsfähigsten Großradaranlagen.
Die Abteilung „Radararchitekturen & Verfahren zur Weltraumbeobachtung" (RVW) befasst sich mit Forschungsthemen zur Aufklärung und Überwachung von Objekten im erdnahen Weltraum mit Radar. Dazu entwerfen wir innovative Verfahren zur Detektion, Ortung, Bahngewinnung und Radarabbildung bis hin zu Methoden zur Analyse und Identifizierung von Weltraumobjekten. Zum experimentellen Nachweis und zur Anwendung dieser Verfahren entwickeln wir Instrumente für unsere Großradaranlage TIRA und Systemarchitekturen für zukünftige Radarsysteme.
Die Gruppe „TIRA - Signalverarbeitung & Digitale Systeme" (TIRA-SVDS) entwickelt mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Ingenieuren, Informatikern und Wissenschaftlern innovative leistungsfähige Radarinstrumente. Neben dem Gesamtsystementwurf und seiner Modellierung sind die Radarsignalerzeugung und -aufzeichnung sowie die echtzeitliche als auch operationelle Signalverarbeitung Kernkompetenzen der Gruppe. Weiterhin beschäftigt sich TIRA-SVDS mit den zum Einsatz der Radarinstrumente erforderlichen Hardware- und Softwarelösungen. Die Gruppe verifiziert die Arbeiten durch die Konzeption, Durchführung und Analyse von Experimenten mit der Großradaranlage TIRA.
Im Rahmen aktueller Forschungs- und Technologieprojekte wird die Großradaranlage TIRA grundlegend modernisiert und um neue Fähigkeiten sowie Systeme erweitert. Gemeinsam mit Ihren Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Wissenschaft und Technik arbeiten Sie interdisziplinär an anspruchsvollen Entwicklungsaufgaben. Sie entwickeln, integrieren und optimieren moderne Radarsysteme zur Weltraumbeobachtung und ihrer Unterbaugruppen - von der Architektur und Signalverarbeitung bis zu Software, Tests und Validierung.
Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung
 * Entwurf und Auslegung von Radarsystemen und deren Untersystemen
 * Entwicklung von Systemarchitekturen, Schnittstellen und Signalverarbeitungskonzepten
 * Implementierung und Integration von Radarsoftware und Algorithmen
 * Durchführung von Simulationen, Tests, Messungen und Validierungen

Job Description 
 Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. The grid interconnection is where our system meets the utility – getting it right is fundamental to a safe, compliant and reliable product across every market we serve.
 As Grid Systems Engineer, you will design and develop the medium-voltage grid interconnection aspects of our power conversion system – from prototype construction and checkout through certification and volume production. You will work closely with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Test & Field teams, and with our external test & certification partners, to ensure our systems meet grid codes and interconnection requirements across our target markets.
 It is a unique opportunity to shape the grid interface of a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Design and develop the medium-voltage (13.8kV–35kV) grid interconnection system and related electromechanical/electronic equipment; prepare related installation, operation and maintenance specifications and instructions.
 • Analyze equipment to establish operating data and conduct experimental tests on grid-interface hardware (transformers, protection, switchgear interfaces) under realistic grid conditions.
 • Analyze engineering proposals and technical data to determine the feasibility of new equipment or modifications to existing designs for different grid voltage levels and markets.
 • Responsible for prototype construction and checkout of grid-interconnection subsystems, supporting our Prototype and Alpha Customer milestones.
 • Compile operational data and prepare customer application information and documentation for grid-tied deployments.
 • Ensure compliance with grid codes, interconnection standards and utility requirements (e.g., IEEE 519, IEEE 1547, IEC 61850, UL 1741) and support certification processes together with our test & certification partners (UL, TÜV, IEC 62477).
 • Collaborate with the Power Electronics and Firmware teams on protection coordination, fault ride-through, and control strategies for grid-tied operation.
 • Respond to customer and partner technical requests regarding grid interconnection requirements as they occur.
 • Support scaling of the grid-interface design across different grid codes and markets as we move from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness.
 Qualifications 
 • BSc / MSc in electrical engineering, power systems engineering or comparable education.
 • Experience in medium-voltage grid interconnection, power systems, or utility-scale grid-tied power electronics (e.g. solar/wind/BESS inverters, solid-state transformers) preferred.
 • Familiarity with grid codes and interconnection standards (e.g. IEEE 519, IEEE 1547, IEC 61850, IEC 61400, IEC 62933, VDE-AR-N, UL 1741).
 • Hands-on experience with prototype build, checkout and test of electromechanical/electronic equipment.
 • Strong analytical skills; comfortable designing and running experimental tests, analyzing the resulting data, and documenting the results.
 • Team player, comfortable engaging directly with customers and partners on technical requirements.
 • Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.
 • The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich in Switzerland. National and international willingness to travel is assumed.
 Benefits 
 • Equity + competitive salary.
 • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.
 • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
 The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. 
 An overview of this role 
 As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.
 In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.
 What you'll do 
 Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
 Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
 Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
 Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
 Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
 Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
 Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.
 What you'll bring 
 Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
 Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
 Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
 Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
 Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
 Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
 Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
 Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.
 About the team 
 The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.
 Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

items.jobDescription:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow. 
 Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 528 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact. 
 The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions. 
 🎯 What we expect from you ? 
 The Flexeo technology enables the development of individual electronic devices on ultraflexible substrates. Within the Flexeo3D project , the objective is to integrate these devices into stretchable matrices to develop wearable prototypes for augmented perception. 
 The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to the development of a complete, autonomous system integrating sensors, a microcontroller, a power source and sensory-feedback actuators, in close collaboration with two PhD students working on sensing and haptic feedback technologies. The ultimate goal is to integrate the system into an ergonomic, breathable wearable sleeve. 
 A key challenge is the development of flexible and stretchable interconnections between system modules. Particular attention will be paid to investigating optical communication channels as a potential solution for data transmission. This will involve a state-of-the-art review, the design and fabrication of dedicated test structures, and the evaluation of optical bus communication technologies. 
 Building on the developed integration technologies, the researcher will contribute to the realization of a fully functional wearable demonstrator, in close collaboration with the researcher responsible for the electronic system design. 
 Experimental work in the laboratory and technological development are essentialand will partly be conducted in our cleanroom and our prototyping Platform (ID-Fab) These efforts will contribute to the creation of radically new demonstrators, opening new avenues for exploration in augmented 
 🔍 What we are looking for ? 
 A person with a PhD or Master's degree in Engineering Sciences, physics and material science. 
 The ideal profile we would like to recruit is the following: 
 Knowledge 
 ·         Engineering sciences, optics and optoelectronic devices. 
 ·         Thin-film fabrication processes 
 ·         3D design. 
 Experience and practical skills 
 ·         Hands-on experience in guided optics and optical/optoelectronic devices. 
 ·         Practical experience in experimental development, prototyping and laboratory work. 
 ·         Experience with stretchable devices would be an advantage. 
 Personal qualities 
 ·         Resourceful, pragmatic and curious, with a hands-on mindset (mandatory). 
 ·         Autonomous and proactive, with the ability to work in a collaborative R&D environment. 
 ·         Good scientific communication skills. 
 If you feel that your background and skills are a good fit for this position, even if you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply ! 
 🌍 Why join Mines Saint-Étienne ? 
 We support each of our employees on the path to excellence, with the conviction that together, we can have a lasting and significant impact on our world. 
 Joining Mines Saint-Etienne is the opportunity to find: 
  •             A stimulating environment: Cutting-edge experimental resources, a welcoming working environment and a solid international network (T.I.M.E., EULIST). 
 •             A real impact: Contractual research projects worth €11 million/year, mainly with industrial partners, A science culture centre, La Rotonde , which has been committed to science outreach for 25 years, welcoming over 50,000 visitors per year. 
 •             An incomparable quality of life: 49 days of paid leave, partial remote working, 75% reimbursed public transport, financial support for carpooling and cycling and a social barometer where 83% of employees praise the quality of life at work. 
 Let's build a more sustainable future, through science, engineering, and projects that make sense.

 Category: Engineering
