items.jobDescription:
We Are
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
 You Are
 You have built software that sits between hardware and the people who need to verify it works. The kind of code that does not get applause but absolutely gets noticed when it breaks. You understand that a clean API matters more than clever code, and that the best abstraction is the one that makes the next engineer's job easier, not the one that shows off what you know.
 You are comfortable in C++ when performance matters and Python when speed of iteration matters, and you know which context calls for which. Hardware interfaces do not intimidate you. You have worked with protocols like AXI or similar interconnects, maybe not as a hardware designer but enough to model them, debug them, and make them behave in a software stack.
 Debugging across boundaries is where you thrive. When an issue spans a hardware model, an IP component, and a platform integration layer, you do not wait for someone else to triangulate it. You dig in, reproduce it, and fix it in a way that does not create three new problems downstream.
 At Synopsys, you will work on the software and workflows that power emulation, prototyping, and hardware-assisted verification platforms used to build some of the most complex chips in the world.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Design and develop C/C++ system software and platform components that support emulation, IP integration, and EDA workflows used across Synopsys hardware-assisted verification platforms
 Build subsystem-level frameworks that enable integration, validation, and reuse of IP and EDA components across multi-team engineering environments
 Develop system-level models, interfaces, and APIs that enable hardware/software co-development, platform validation, and early software bring-up
 Write Python-based automation and tooling to orchestrate workflows, accelerate platform development, and improve engineering productivity
 Work with hardware interfaces and protocols such as AXI, including software models and transaction-level abstractions that bridge hardware IP and system software
 Test, debug, profile, and optimize complex software components across large C/C++ and Linux-based codebases using tools like GDB and Valgrind
 Collaborate with IP, EDA, verification, emulation, prototyping, and firmware teams to translate system requirements into scalable, maintainable software solutions
 The Impact You Will Have
 Your platform software will enable engineering teams to integrate, validate, and deploy IP and EDA components faster and with fewer integration failures
 The frameworks you build will be reused across multiple product lines, reducing duplicate work and accelerating time to deployment for new platform features
 Your automation and tooling will directly improve developer productivity, cutting down manual workflow steps and reducing time spent debugging environment issues
 The APIs and abstractions you design will make it easier for downstream teams to build on top of your work without needing to understand every layer beneath it
 Your debugging work will unblock critical issues that span hardware models, software stacks, and EDA tools, keeping platform development on schedule
 The system-level models you develop will enable earlier software bring-up and more accurate co-verification, reducing costly late-stage integration surprises
 Your contributions to build infrastructure, regression frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines will improve code quality and deployment reliability across the team
 What You'll Need
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 Strong hands-on programming skills in C and C++, including object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, memory management, debugging, and multithreaded or concurrent software concepts
 Working proficiency in Python for automation, scripting, tooling, or workflow development
 Solid understanding of Linux-based software development environments and debugging practices
 Ability to debug issues across multi-component software systems and diagnose problems that span hardware models, IP, platform software, and verification environments
 Experience with SystemC and Transaction-Level Modeling (TLM 2.0) is a plus
 Familiarity with AMBA/AXI protocols or similar SoC interconnect technologies is a plus
 Who You Are
 You can move between hardware concepts, system-level models, C/C++ software, Python automation, and EDA workflows without losing the thread of what you are actually building
 You do not wait for perfect documentation or fully defined requirements, you ask the right questions, align with stakeholders, and find a way through ambiguity
 When you build an API or framework, you think about the engineer who will use it six months from now, not just the one who needs it today
 You can explain a complex tradeoff between performance, maintainability, and time to delivery in a way that helps the team make the right call
 You treat debugging as a skill, not a chore, and you know how to isolate a problem across subsystem boundaries without creating noise for other teams
 You care about code quality, modularity, and maintainability because you have seen what happens when those things are ignored in a large codebase
 The Team You'll Be Part Of
 You will be part of the Synopsys Hardware Assisted Verification (HAV) team, a worldwide leader in hardware and software co-verification solutions. The team delivers transaction-based co-emulation, in-circuit emulation, and prototyping platforms that enable customers to accelerate hardware verification, software bring-up, system validation, and system-level development for advanced semiconductor designs. You will collaborate with IP, EDA, verification, emulation, prototyping, firmware, and platform engineering teams across Synopsys.
 Rewards and Benefits
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Graduate Engineer – Robotics, Automation & Maintenance (m/f/d) 
 Start your career at JINGDONG Logistics 
 Your degree is nearly finished. Ready to see your knowledge in motion? 
 Join JINGDONG Logistics and take your first career step in automated warehouse logistics. Work with robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial control systems—and help keep hundreds of autonomous guided vehicles (AGVs) operating safely and reliably.
 This entry-level opportunity is aimed at final-year students and recent graduates seeking a practical, hands-on engineering role .
 Your role 
 As part of our technical team, you will support the maintenance, troubleshooting, and improvement of equipment used in our logistics operations. You will apply your engineering knowledge to real technical challenges and build practical experience across mechanical, electrical, and automated systems.
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Supporting preventive maintenance and inspections of automated equipment.
 Investigating faults and assisting with repairs to mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems.
 Helping maintain the reliable operation of warehouse robots and conveyor systems.
 Assisting with equipment installation, testing, and commissioning.
 Using technical drawings, electrical schematics, and diagnostic tools.
 Documenting maintenance work and identifying opportunities to improve equipment performance.
 Following safety procedures and working closely with technical and operations colleagues.
 Your profile 
 You are in the final stages of, or have recently completed, a degree in Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Robotics, or a related discipline .
 You enjoy practical engineering and want to work directly with machinery and automated systems.
 You bring technical foundations from university projects, laboratory work, internships, or personal projects.
 You approach problems systematically and work carefully, independently, and collaboratively.
 Initial knowledge of PLCs, industrial automation, or electrical schematics is welcome.
 You are willing to work in an operational warehouse environment, including shifts and weekend work where required.
 Previous full-time professional experience is not required. 
 What you can look forward to 
 Robotics at scale: A modern warehouse logistics environment with hundreds of AGVs operating simultaneously.
 Practical engineering experience: Direct exposure to robotics, conveyor technology, and industrial equipment.
 Varied technical challenges: Opportunities to develop your maintenance, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills.
 Visible impact: Your contribution helps keep daily logistics operations moving.
 An international team: Collaboration with colleagues from different technical and cultural backgrounds.
 Room to contribute: Opportunities to suggest improvements to equipment reliability and maintenance processes.
 Apply and put your engineering knowledge to work. 
 Please submit your CV, expected graduation date, and earliest possible start date . Feel free to include relevant university projects, internships, or practical technical experience.
 JINGDONG Logistics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds.

items.jobDescription:
What To Expect
 Join the mission to launch Cybercab, Tesla’s revolutionary fully autonomous Robotaxi, on the most advanced automotive manufacturing lines in the world. As a Cybercab Engineer, you won’t just support the lines… you will own them. You become a key individual partnering with cross-functional teams, to execute, and relentlessly optimize processes during the high-stakes ramping phase.
You’ll drive Tesla’s novel manufacturing method, the groundbreaking approach that breaks the vehicle into major modules built in parallel on open, highly accessible stations before final joining. This isn’t traditional automotive manufacturing. This is a radical, high-speed, modular manufacturing revolution, redesigned to shrink footprints, and unlocks blistering production rates.
These lines are loaded with cutting-edge automation and robotics. You’ll lead the deployment of advanced equipment process, focusing on quality/efficiency/safety targets, and execute an aggressive production ramp that few in the industry will ever experience. You’ll turn the most ambitious vehicle Tesla has ever built into reality at scale.
This is an opportunity to own world-class lines, master Unboxed manufacturing, and help write the next chapter of the automotive history.
 What You'll Do
 Review critical process metrics daily for statistical shifts from nominal and develop game plans to address
 Identify and/or develop critical process monitors and metrics for Drive Unit, Stator, Rotor and Assembly.
 Use to diagnose issues found during the manufacturing process, efficiently identify root cause, react (but also plan proactively)
 Guide and develop roadmaps for aggressive improvement to OEE metrics: Yield, Cycle Time,
 Availability, and Cost. Report metrics to upper management
 Manage workload with a positive attitude as a team player in a collaborative work environment
 Drive continuous improvement and support activities for engineering and manufacturing including 5S and Lean manufacturing activities, material handling improvements, production line configuration, and safety procedures
 High flexibility for supporting several Lines and capability to solve mid-to-high complex topics
 What You'll Bring
 B.S. in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Electrical Engineering or the equivalent in experience and evidence of exceptional ability.
 Ideally gained some experience in a manufacturing environment.
 First experience with process engineering (process development/improvement, troubleshooting, data analysis, constraint analysis, flow optimization, root cause analysis, etc.).
 Strong team working skills at all levels of an organization, especially skilled at working with direct labor to understand challenges and work on developing optimal solutions using structured methods.
 Capable of identifying critical process parameters and applying statistics to process measurement and control.
 Comfortable providing clear and focused technical guidance to outside engineering resources, as well as the Production Team.
 Ability to read and interpret basic mechanical and electrical drawings.
 Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of programs.
 Fluent in English, German is nice to have.
, Tesla

Job Title

 Job Description
 #EOS
 Job Title
 Sr. Electrical Engineer - STET
 Your Role
 Sustaining Engineering and Lifecycle Management
 Lead sustaining activities including component obsolescence management, supplier change requests, cost reduction, reliability improvements, and design compliance updates.
 Oversee system-level redesign projects to address end-of-life risks, improve manufacturability, and maintain regulatory compliance.
 Ensure all design changes are documented and executed in accordance with Philips Quality Management System (QMS) and regulatory standards.
 Drive product development activities including development of design concepts, prototype testing, engineering specs, and module/system level tests.
 Drive continuous improvement projects related to design implementation, manufacturing process, product quality and reliability
 Technical Expertise and Problem Resolution
 Provide subject matter expertise in power electronics and analog circuits, ultrasound system modules.
 Lead complex root cause investigations using schematic reviews, PCB layout analysis, assembly documentation, and BOM assessments.
 Guide development of verification protocols, oversee module/system validation activities, and approve qualification testing results.
 Support system integration activities and ensure electrical designs meet system-level requirements and standards.
 Leadership and Representation
 Serve as the lead engineer and primary representative of the electrical engineering team in program reviews, design reviews, and cross-functional forums.
 Collaborate with systems, mechanical, manufacturing, and quality engineering teams to ensure alignment on technical direction and project priorities.
 Provide clear communication of technical risks, mitigation plans, and recommendations to project leadership and stakeholders.
 Mentorship and Team Development
 Mentor and coach junior engineers, providing technical guidance and promoting knowledge sharing.
 Contribute to team capability development by instilling best practices in design, testing, documentation, and compliance.
 Act as a role model for professional conduct and collaborative engagement across teams.
 Job Requirements
 Education
 Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university
 15 years’ minimum experience in Engineering, product design and development.
 Qualification & Skills
 Technical Competencies
 Experience in electrical design, development, or sustaining engineering, preferably in medical devices or other regulated industries.
 Demonstrated expertise in analog design, digital design, and/or power electronics at both circuit and system levels.
 Prior experience in sustaining engineering or lifecycle management of complex electronic systems.
 Experience with regulatory compliance, verification/validation processes, and design documentation in regulated environments.
 Strong skills in circuit analysis, PCB design review, hardware validation, and system-level integration.
 Proficiency in failure analysis, corrective action, and risk mitigation.
 Technical writing and documentation skills for regulated product environments.
 Leadership and Interpersonal Skills
 Proven ability to lead engineering teams, influence decision-making, and represent technical functions in cross-functional forums.
 Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
 Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and develop junior engineers.
 Collaborative and outward-facing approach – able to build professional networks, foster strong relationships, and represent the team effectively.
 High level of accountability, adaptability, and professional integrity.
 How We Work Together
 We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
 About Philips
 Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

WHO WE ARE 
 Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
 Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
 Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.
 TEAM & ROLE 
 Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

 Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.
 WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION 
 You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.
 You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.
 Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.
 Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.
 YOUR IMPACT 
 You will support the industrialisation of production processes for magnet production, contributing directly to the execution of key activities within Proxima’s magnet program.
 You will play a central role in designing, programming and operating automation cells performing a wide array of production processes such as welding, bonding, sealing and coating.
 You will operate across a wide range of technical tasks, from design and engineering to hands on production work, and collaborating closely with engineers and technicians
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 Advise on future line design and automation concepts
 Define the requirements for automation cells for different processes to ensure performance, repeatability and safe operation
 Contribute to the development of control strategies for new production lines
 You will build and commission automation cells, including running FAT at supplier sites
 Identify and test different manufacturing and in-process monitoring approaches
 Design jigs and tools for magnet industrialised production
 Support in the process development and prototyping of magnets, with scalability and repeatability in mind.
 Collaborate closely with engineers and technicians across multiple teams
 WHO YOU ARE 
 A master´s degree in mechanical, mechatronics or similar engineering field
 A wide experience in robotics, automation and process monitoring in an industrial setting
 Strong hands-on experience in production environments over a wide range of production processes (for ex. welding, machining, assembly, bonding)
 Experience with robotic simulation and offline programming (e.g. RoboGuide, RobotStudio, Process Simulate). Previous work on FANUC systems is a plus
 Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Ethernet, Profinet)
 Proficient in industrial-level PLC programming
 Ability to work across a variety of tasks in a dynamic environment
 Reliable, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset
 Strong team player, able to collaborate closely with engineers and technical staff
 A high performer who loves challenges and is not afraid to experiment, take risks and learn from mistakes.
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Familiarity in both prototype manufacturing and industrial manufacturing
 Proficiency in CAD: good knowledge of Catia V5 or 3DExperience are considered as a plus
 Exposure to SCADA systems or MES integration
 Familiarity with Beckhoff PLC and motion control
 Knowledge of safety standards and risk assessments in automated environments

Your mission 
 As a Thermal Simulation Engineer, you join the early team and own the thermal performance of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. From transient heat spikes during peak actuator loads to the airflow in our cooling ducts, you make sure every watt finds its way out - keeping our robots reliable under real duty cycles, not just in a demo.
 Key responsibilities 
 Transient Thermal Analysis: Model the transient events that define real operation - peak loads, duty-cycle heat spikes and thermal soak - not just steady state.
 CFD & Cooling Design: Simulate airflow and heat transfer through ducts, heat sinks and cooling loops, covering both active and passive cooling architectures.
 System-Level Thermal Management: Define thermal budgets across the robot and translate them into concrete cooling requirements for the design teams.
 Design Collaboration: Partner with the design engineers from the earliest concept stage, turning simulation insight into design decisions rather than after-the-fact checks.
 Validation: Correlate simulation results with physical thermal testing to continuously refine model accuracy.
 Your profile 
 We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.
 Must-haves 
 Experience: 5+ years in thermal engineering and CFD in high-performance robotics, aerospace or automotive engineering, with a track record of cooling architectures that held up under real peak loads.
 CFD Mastery: Expert level in CFD tools (e.g. Ansys Fluent/Icepak or comparable) for airflow and cooling analysis, validated against physical measurements.
 Transient Thermal Simulation: Deep expertise in modeling transient thermal behavior under dynamic, high-peak-power operating conditions.
 Cooling System Design: Practical knowledge of fan selection, duct and heat sink design and passive cooling architectures.
 CAD Fluency: Comfortable in CAD and in coupling thermal results with structural workflows.
 Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge mechanical, electrical and software teams, and you iterate until predicted and measured behavior match.
 Nice-to-haves 
 Battery & Electronics Cooling: Experience with liquid cooling, cold plates and thermal interface materials for batteries and compute.
 Thermal Testing: Hands-on experience with thermal imaging, sensor logging and climate chamber tests.
 Scripting & Automation: Python or similar to automate pre- and post-processing.
 Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.
 Why us? 
 The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.
 Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.
 Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.
 Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
 About us 
 We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
 Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, We fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
 Our Locations 
 We have two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all builders.

Why us?
 POLARIS Raumflugzeuge GmbH develops innovative transportation systems that redefine access to space for payloads and passengers. We are continuing to expand our team and are looking to fill the position of Aerothermodynamics Engineer (m/f/d) for Supersonic and Hypersonic Vehicles .
Join our dynamic and fast-growing startup and be part of our exciting journey to revolutionize space transportation and hypersonics. We are a passionate team dedicated to pushing boundaries, fostering innovation, and creating impactful solutions that make a difference.
Depending on the area of responsibility, professional experience and specialist background, the gross annual salary ranges from EUR 60.000,00 to EUR 100.000,00.
The exact remuneration will be determined during the application process.
 Your mission
 Analysis of external aerodynamics for a two-staged aircraft configuration for flow regimes from subsonic to hypersonic 
 Analysis of aerothermodynamics for spaceplanes in the hypersonic regime
 Applying multi-fidelity numerical, analytical, and empirical methods for the analysis of aerodynamics and aerothermodynamics problems
 Conduction of CFD analyses in the flow regime from subsonic to hypersonic including preprocessing and postprocessing tasks
 Analysis of inlet flows in the frame of air-breathing propulsion analysis
 Your profile
 Requirements
 Successfully completed aerospace engineering degree or similar (M.Sc.)
 Experience in aerodynamics, aerothermodynamics, and flight mechanics
 Extensive experience with CFD software (e.g. Ansys, DLR TAU, ...)
 Experience with CAD software (e.g. PTC Creo) 
 Proactive thinking, high level of motivation, flexibility, and team-working skills
 Experience with working in a startup environment favorable
 Proficiency in English
 Advantageous
 High-Sweep/Fighter Aircraft Aerodynamics
 Laminar-Turbulent Transition
 URANS Experience
 Hybrid RANS/LES experience
 Multi-Fidelity Aerodynamics Experience
 Flight testing preparation, experimental design
 Flight testing/experimental data experience (Windtunnel data)
 Flutter & Buffeting, Aeroelasticity & FSI
 What We Offer
 Long-term prospects with a permanent employment contract
 Being part of an international, highly motivated team
 Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes
 Flexible working hours

 Monthly subsidy of €30 for public transportation ("Deutschlandticket")

 Join us in shaping the future of space transportation and making a positive impact. If your profile fits our requirements, apply now by sending your complete application portfolio, including CV, certificates, and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role.

 Our mission is to pioneer a new era of space transportation by flying to space and back like an aircraft — taking off and landing at airports, and reusing our spaceplanes for hundreds of missions. We combine unprecedented cost efficiency with unique flexibility and safety, enabling breakthrough advances in both space transportation and hypersonic flight. This vision is currently pursued by over 115 employees every day.

KIT – Science for Impact. Akademische Mitarbeiterin / Akademischer Mitarbeiter (w/m/d) mit abgeschlossener Promotion Agentenbasierte KI für autonome Mikroskopie und optofluidische Robotik Institut für Biologische und Chemische Systeme - Funktionelle Molekulare Systeme (IBCS-FMS) 2 Jahre ab sofort Vollzeit 66.800,00 bis 81.900,00 EUR brutto pro Jahr Aufgabenbereich Ihre Aufgaben An der Schnittstelle von Optofluidik und künstlicher Intelligenz entwickeln wir robuste Experiment-Plattformen, in denen Laser-induzierte Strömungen Zellen und mikroskopische Objekte präzise manipulieren. Unser Ziel: zuverlässige Laborhardware in autonome Forschungsplattformen zu verwandeln - gesteuert durch Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die Experimente planen, Instrumente kontrollieren, Ergebnisse auswerten und Workflows eigenständig verbessern. Ihre Tätigkeit im Einzelnen: Entwicklung und Integration von KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Workflows mit etablierten optofluidischen und mikroskopischen Setups. Aufbau von Python-Schnittstellen, APIs und Instrumentensteuerungen zur Erfassung und Kontrolle von Experimenten inkl. Feedback. Kombinieren Sie quantitative Bildanalyse, maschinelles Lernen, Rückkopplungssteuerung und Optimierung, um adaptive Experimente und autonome wissenschaftliche Datengenerierung zu ermöglichen. Planung von Experimenten mit KI-Agenten-Bewertung, Sicherheitsmaßnahmen, reproduzierbaren Protokollen und systematischer Handhabung von Fehlern. Arbeiten Sie mit einem interdisziplinären Team zusammen und veröffentlichen Sie neue Methoden und wissenschaftliche Ergebnisse in Biophotonik und physikalischer KI. Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays 
 Location: Germering, on-site
 About the hiring company: 
 Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart.
 At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond.
 About the role 
 Space hardware must survive launch before it can perform its mission. Your analyses and tests will prove that it can.
 As Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will verify the structures and mechanisms that enable Dcubed's solar arrays to survive launch and deploy successfully in orbit. Through a combination of advanced simulation, first-principles engineering, and hands-on testing, you will turn ambitious designs into flight-ready hardware.
 If you enjoy understanding the physics behind complex systems, challenging assumptions, and validating your work through testing, this role is for you.
 Responsibilities 
 Perform structural analyses of solar arrays, deployable structures, mechanisms, and hold-down and release systems.
 Develop and validate FEM models for static, dynamic, thermoelastic, buckling, and non-linear analyses.
 Size composite and metallic structures, bonded joints, bolted interfaces, and inserts, and calculate structural margins of safety.
 Use analytical calculations and engineering judgement to cross-check simulation results and verify model assumptions.
 Support the design of lightweight structures and mechanisms capable of surviving launch loads and deploying successfully in orbit.
 Define and lead structural test campaigns, including vibration, static load, deployment, and thermal testing.
 Define loads, instrumentation, notching approaches, test predictions, and pass/fail criteria.
 Participate in test execution, investigate anomalies, correlate models, and support verification closure.
 Build and test coupons, prototypes, and representative hardware to generate material data and validate analytical models.
 Prepare structural analyses, test reports, and verification documentation, and support internal and customer reviews.
 Candidate Requirements 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline.
 3+ years of experience in structural analysis and testing of aerospace, space, or other high-performance structures.
 Experience taking hardware from analysis through testing and verification.
 Experience with composite structures, deployable systems, mechanisms, or spacecraft hardware is highly desirable.
 Technical Skills 
 Strong understanding of structural mechanics, dynamics, vibration, and load-path analysis.
 Advanced FEM knowledge and strong experience with FEMAP and Nastran NX.
 Experience with Ansys and LS-Dyna is considered an advantage.
 Experience performing static, modal, random vibration, transient, buckling, thermoelastic, and non-linear analyses.
 Experience sizing composite and metallic structures, bolted joints, inserts, and bonded interfaces.
 Ability to assess structural margins and independently verify simulation results using first-principles calculations.
 Experience defining and executing structural test campaigns, including instrumentation, notching, and model correlation.
 Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for engineering calculations and data analysis.
 Familiarity with ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace structural standards.
 Personal Attributes 
 Analytical, rigorous, and driven to understand the physics behind the results.
 Strong sense of ownership from analysis through successful test execution.
 Hands-on mindset with a willingness to prototype, instrument, and test hardware.
 Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
 Effective communicator and team player in a multidisciplinary environment.
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
 Excellent English language skills.
 Eligibility to work in Germany
 What we offer 
 We want you to feel welcome and have the best possible tools for your work here at Dcubed. Therefore, we have selected a set of benefits to support your work days and everyday life, today and longer term.
 Commute: Deutschlandticket
 Wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass, recovery toolkit
 ETF-based pension program offering 30-50% company contribution
 Modern work equipment, based on your role and needs: laptop, phone, headphones, electric desk, wide screens, state-of-the-art workshop equipment
 Office environment: kitchen and break areas; lunch offering, beverages & snacks at the office; small exercise area, Space Bar
 Work-life balance & activities: hybrid work arrangements (location and working hours), company events and trips, launch parties
 Professional development: 70-20-10 thinking, training budget, training library, regular performance reviews
 Company swag: hoodie, t-shirt, stickers, water bottle, notebook etc.

items.jobDescription:
Meet DeepL 
 DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
 Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
 What sets us apart 
 What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
 When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
 What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .
 Meet the team behind this journey 
 You will join the team building and operating DeepL for Sovereign Markets, our offering for public sector bodies and regulated organisations that need more than data residency. It is hosted and operated entirely within the EU, under EU jurisdiction, and runs alongside DeepL's global infrastructure. The team is designing the platform foundations that make that promise true in practice: how services are built, deployed, secured, observed and operated. The approach favours managed infrastructure and well designed software abstractions over bespoke low level plumbing. You will work closely with product, security and legal colleagues as the offering grows to cover more capabilities and features.
 Your responsibilities 
 Build the platform as software: Design and build the platform layer of DeepL for Sovereign Markets as software: reusable services, abstractions and tooling that product engineers build on
 Own the architecture: Own the architecture of the managed infrastructure the platform runs on, including Kubernetes, networking, storage, identity and secrets, using provider managed services where they meet the requirement
 Standardise and automate: Define infrastructure as code and delivery standards that hold across teams, and automate operations so that manual work is the exception
 Make design decisions visible and reviewable: write and review architecture decision records, weigh positions on their merits and commit once a decision is made
 Build for reliability: Build observability, resilience testing and incident response practices so that the service meets its reliability commitments
 Adapt the product to the new environment: Make low invasive modifications to existing code in the product with confidence in order to make it run in the new environment
 Keep the environment auditable: Work with security and compliance colleagues to keep the environment auditable and aligned with the standards our customers require
 Raise the technical bar: Mentor engineers, raise the technical bar through design reviews, and build consensus across teams without relying on line authority
 Participation in our on-call rotation: You’ll ensure the reliability and availability of our services by being available to join the team's shared on-call rotation as needed
 Qualities we look for 
 Software engineering depth: Strong software engineering skills in at least one major language, C#, Go or Python preferred, shown by tooling, services or platform abstractions that other engineers rely on
 Production infrastructure: Production experience designing and running managed infrastructure and Kubernetes, with sound judgement on when to use provider managed services and when not to
 Automation and delivery: Infrastructure as code with Terraform, Crossplane or equivalent, and GitOps delivery, applied to environments you have owned
 AI-Native Velocity: You leverage AI-powered tools (like GitHub Copilot or Claude) to accelerate your velocity and eliminate repetitive toil. You use AI for boilerplate code, test generation, and debugging, allowing you to focus your cognitive energy on high-value architectural decisions and complex problem-solving
 A track record of technical ownership across several teams: you create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions and change them on evidence
 Reliability discipline: observability, incident response and designing for failure, with experience carrying on-call
 Security fundamentals: Working knowledge of infrastructure security fundamentals, such as identity, secrets, network segmentation and supply chain hygiene
 Clear written communication: you can capture a decision so that others can build on it
 You’d get bonus points for 
 Experience in regulated or audited environments, for example BSI C5, ISO 27001 or SOC2 
 Experience with EU based or sovereign cloud providers
 Chaos engineering and game day practice
 Building platforms for small teams through a high degree of automation
 What we offer 
 Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
 Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
 Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
 Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
 Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
 Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
 Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
 If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!
 We are an equal opportunity employer 
 You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

Job Description 
 Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based AC/DC and DC/DC power blocks. Operating at these voltage and power levels, electromagnetic compatibility and regulatory compliance are not an afterthought – they are core to a safe, certifiable, and market-ready product across every region we serve.
 As EMC / Compliance Engineer, you will own the EMC and regulatory compliance strategy for our power conversion systems – from early design guidance through formal certification with our external test houses and certification bodies. You will work closely with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Mechanical teams to make sure compliance is designed in from the start, not tested in at the end.
 It is a unique opportunity to build the compliance function for a breakthrough power electronics platform from an early stage – with direct visibility to the CTO and engineering leadership.
 Key Responsibilities 
 • Plan, execute and oversee EMC testing (conducted and radiated emissions and immunity) for our AC/DC and DC/DC power conversion systems, in collaboration with external test houses.
 • Define and drive the regulatory compliance strategy and certification roadmap across our target markets and standards (e.g. UL, CE, IEC 62477, IEEE 1547, FCC/CISPR EMC standards).
 • Work with the Power Electronics, Firmware and Mechanical teams early in the design phase to build in EMC and compliance considerations – shielding, filtering, grounding and layout – from the start.
 • Own relationships with external certification bodies and test houses (UL, TÜV, and others), coordinating test plans, submissions and follow-up on findings.
 • Prepare and maintain technical documentation required for certification – test reports, risk assessments, and declarations of conformity.
 • Investigate and resolve EMC and compliance issues found during testing, supporting root-cause analysis and design changes together with engineering.
 • Track evolving regulatory requirements across our target markets and communicate their impact on the engineering roadmap.
 • Support the transition from Alpha Customer readiness to Production and Volume Readiness by scaling compliance processes to serial production.
 Qualifications 
 • BSc / MSc in electrical engineering or comparable education.
 • 5+ years of experience in EMC engineering and/or regulatory compliance, ideally for power electronics or industrial medium-voltage equipment.
 • Strong knowledge of EMC standards (e.g. IEC 61000 series, CISPR, FCC Part 15) and product safety / grid-tie standards (UL, IEC 62477, IEEE 1547).
 • Hands-on experience with EMC test equipment and pre-compliance testing.
 • Experience working with external test houses and certification bodies.
 • Strong documentation skills; comfortable preparing test plans, reports and technical files for certification.
 • Team player, comfortable working cross-functionally with hardware and firmware teams early in the design cycle.
 • Language skills: fluent in English, spoken and written; German language skills helpful, but not mandatory.
 • The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich in Switzerland, with occasional travel to test houses and certification bodies.
 Benefits 
 • Equity + competitive salary.
 • Unique technology and market opportunity – validated prototype and first paying customers on the path to volume shipments.
 • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

Join Instil’s agentic product development team for your placement year and learn to build software the way it will be built in the agentic age: engineers owning the problem, the architecture and the key decisions, with AI agents accelerating everything in between.
 About the role 
 At Instil, agentic product engineering is how we deliver. Our teams work alongside an agentic workforce that generates requirements, builds across parallel workstreams, runs continuous quality and security checks or monitoring systems in production. The result is software that ships faster, with lower risk.
 The agents do a lot, but people stay firmly in charge - orchestrating. We own the problem, the architecture and the key decisions. That is the skill set we will help you build from day one.
 As a placement student you will join a delivery team working on real client products for organisations ranging from ambitious start-ups to global brands. You will learn the fundamentals of great software engineering and, alongside them, how to direct, review and get the best out of AI agents.
 What you'll do 
 You will work across our full delivery lifecycle, supported by experienced engineers and mentors.
 Plan: take part in discovery with clients, help shape requirements and use agents to turn ideas into rapid prototypes and a backlog ready to build.
 Build: write, review and test production code, directing agents across parallel workstreams and learning to judge when their output is right and when it is not.
 Ship: help release software to production, design for observability and use agents to monitor systems, analyse issues and drive improvements.
 Along the way you will: 
 Learn to make sound technical decisions and explain them clearly
 Build good habits in security, testing and code quality, so speed never comes at the cost of trust
 Work directly with clients and colleagues as part of a collaborative, multi-disciplinary team
 Share what you learn, as our ways of working with agents are evolving all the time
 What we're looking for 
 We care more about how you think than what you already know.
 Essential: 
 Currently studying towards a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline, with a placement year as part of your programme
 Solid programming fundamentals in at least one modern language, such as TypeScript, Python, Java, Kotlin, or C#
 Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar, through projects, hackathons or coursework
 Strong problem-solving skills and the judgement to question an answer rather than simply accept it
 Clear communication skills and an enjoyment of working in a team
 Nice to have: 
 Side projects, open source contributions or a portfolio that shows what you have built
 An interest in cloud platforms, security or web and mobile development
 What you'll get 
 A structured placement programme combining engineering fundamentals with hands-on training in agentic development
 A mentor and regular feedback throughout your year
 Real client work from your first weeks, not just internal projects
 Access to the latest AI tools and the time to learn them properly
 A collaborative culture where people share knowledge openly
 A head start into your final year – and a strong foundation for a graduate role
 Placement details 
 Duration: 12 months
 Start date: June/July 2027
 Location: Belfast
 Working pattern: Hybrid – at least 3 days per week in our Belfast Office
 Right to work: Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK
 Eligibility: Open to students in their penultimate year of an undergraduate or integrated master’s degree, with a placement year as part of their programme
 Why Join Instil? 
 At Instil, we believe great work starts with happy, motivated people. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your wellbeing, growth, and life outside of work, because when you thrive, so do we.
 Recognition That Matters: A discretionary annual performance bonus that rewards your impact and contribution to our success.

items.jobDescription:
Das Fraunhofer FHR in Wachtberg bei Bonn ist Teil der großen Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft und eines der führenden und größten europäischen Forschungsinstitute auf dem Gebiet der Hochfrequenzphysik und Radartechnik mit dem weltweit leistungsstärksten Weltraumbeobachtungsradar.
Vor dem Hintergrund der zunehmenden Bedrohung von Satelliten durch Weltraumtrümmer entwickelt das Bereich Radar zur Weltraumlageerfassung (RWL) Radarsysteme für die Weltraumüberwachung. Als Weiterentwicklung des Weltraumüberwachungsradars GESTRA wird das bestehende System um einen zusätzlichen optimierten Radarempfänger sowie einen Sender erweitert. Das bisherige, monolithische System wird daher durch ein verteiltes Software-System ersetzt. Das Projekt bietet Ihnen viele Möglichkeiten Ihre eigenen Ideen, in unsere Software-Landschaft einzubringen.
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung der Softwarearchitektur zur Steuerung und Überwachung vernetzter Radarsysteme
 Analyse und Bewertung fachlicher, technischer und betrieblicher Anforderungen sowie Entwicklung geeigneter Architektur- und Lösungsansätze
 Gestaltung und Bewertung von Schnittstellen zu Radar-, Steuerungs- und weiteren Systemen unter Berücksichtigung von Funktionalität, Sicherheit, Verfügbarkeit und Wartbarkeit
 Planung und Koordinierung der Systemintegration und Verifikation einschließlich geeigneter Integrations-, Test- und Abnahmeverfahren
 Analyse systemübergreifender Fehlerbilder sowie Ableitung und Nachverfolgung geeigneter Fehlerbehebungs- und Änderungsmaßnahmen
 Anwendung einschlägiger ECSS-Standards in Entwicklungs-, Qualitäts- und Verifikationsprozessen einschließlich normgerechter Umsetzung und Dokumentation
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Abgeschlossenes technisches Hochschulstudium, z. B. in den Fachrichtungen Informatik, Mathematik, Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Gute Kenntnisse in der Konzeption und Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme sowie im Schnittstellendesign und in der Bewertung technischer Lösungsansätze
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C++ sowie gute Kenntnisse in C; Erfahrung mit systemnaher Softwareentwicklung ist von Vorteil
 Kenntnisse in Systemintegration, Verifikation, Test und Fehlersuche sowie in der Softwareentwicklung unter Linux
 Erfahrung mit Versionsverwaltung, insbesondere Git, sowie mit Build-Systemen, automatisierten Tests und CI/CD- bzw. DevOps-Werkzeugen
 Kenntnisse in qualitätsgesicherter Softwareentwicklung und technischer Dokumentation; Kenntnisse der ECSS-Normen oder vergleichbarer Entwicklungs-, Qualitäts- und Verifikationsstandards sind von Vorteil
 Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten, Freude an der fachübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Mitarbeit an der Weltraumüberwachungstechnologie der Zukunft, welche wissenschaftlich state-of-the-art und europaweit einmalig ist
 Offenes, internationales und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld in einer professionellen Forschungseinrichtung ausgestattet mit modernsten Geräten
 Mitarbeit in einem anspruchsvollen FuE-Vorhaben mit hohem Praxisbezug
 Regelmäßiger Austausch und Kontakt zu Fachkolleg*innen und renommierten, inter-/nationalen Partnern aus Wissenschaft und Industrie
 Überdurchschnittliche, geförderte Weiterbildungskultur mit vielfältigem Angebot zur persönlichen Entwicklung z.B. durch Teilnahme an Messen, Fachtagungen, Workshops und Seminaren sowie internen Förderprogrammen
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine gute Work-Life-Balance zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf (39 Stundenwoche, Gleitzeitsystem, Brückentagesregelung und Perspektiven des mobilen Arbeitens)
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL) und Jobticket
 Kantine und nahegelegene Einkaufsmöglichkeiten
 Familienfreundliche Kultur, Mit-Kind-Büro, Unterstützung durch externen Dienstleister bei der Notfallbetreuung für Kinder und Angehörige
 Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen richten sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD).
 Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. 
Die Stelle ist im Rahmen des Projekts zunächst auf 2 Jahre befristet. 
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt.  
 Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.  
 Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.   
   Fragen zu dieser Stelle beantwortet Ihnen gerne: 
 Prashant Nilkund, M. Sc.

 Email: prashant.nilkund@fhr.fraunhofer.de 
 Fraunhofer-Institut für Hochfrequenzphysik und Radartechnik FHR  
 www.fhr.fraunhofer.de

About Enact 
The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.
 At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.
 We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.
 If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.
 In This Role 
 You will develop the proprioceptive motion control layer to enable our robots to do high contact manipulation predictably, smoothly, and safely under varied and uncertain conditions.
 Design and implement model- and learning-based estimation and control algorithms, along with the runtime loops that form the backbone for teleoperation and our AI-driven manipulation, from simulation to the real robot system.
 Debug and diagnose complex system behaviors spanning the interplay of hardware, software, and algorithms.
 Own robot bring-up, including validation and refinement of our robot model descriptions (URDF, MuJoCo XML, USD, etc.) for simulation and control, characterizing and adjusting for the sim-to-real gap as needed.
 Work together with both our hardware team and our AI researchers to continuously assess and push the performance of our full stack robot system
 What We're Looking For 
 Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
 Excellent theoretical and practical grasp of model and learning based whole-body control and state estimation
 Experience with robot simulation environments (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or similar) and robot description files (URDF, USD, etc.)
 Proven ability to take complex algorithms from concept through hardware integration to production-ready real-time robot software
 Strong proficiency in Python, complemented by efficient low-level programming skills in Rust or C/C++
 Bonus Points If You Have 
 Hands-on experience with tensor and automatic differentiation frameworks such as JAX, PyTorch, CppAD, Burn, or similar.
 Experience with whole-body force estimation
 Experience in developing reinforcement learning based robot control
 Experience in robot safety, including Control Barrier Functions and/or relevant industry certifications.
 Experience in contact rich manipulation, preferably including teleoperation and interfacing with large behavior models such as VLAs.
 What we offer 
 The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time
 A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team
 Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup
 Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world
 A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders
 Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation

**Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied**
**Siemens Mobility** ist ein eigenständig geführtes Unternehmen der Siemens AG und seit über 160 Jahren ein führender Anbieter im Bereich Mobilität. Zu unserem Kerngeschäft gehören Schienenfahrzeuge, Bahnautomatisierungs- und Elektrifizierungslösungen, schlüsselfertige Systeme sowie die dazugehörigen Serviceleistungen. Wir waren schon immer sehr innovativ, um Reisen schneller, sicherer und komfortabler zu machen. Heute brauchen wir neue Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen wie den Klimawandel und weltweit steigende Bevölkerungszahlen. Das ist es, was uns antreibt. Deshalb gestalten wir Mobilität mit Leidenschaft und sind immer einen Schritt voraus. Your mission 
 As an FEA Simulation Engineer, you join the early team and own the structural integrity of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. Through static and dynamic FEA, you make sure our structures withstand real-world loads while pushing every gram toward best-in-class lightweight targets. Your sign-off is the final gate between a design and its release to hardware.
 Key responsibilities 
 Structural Integrity: Lead static and dynamic FEA on load-bearing structures, delivering sign-offs based on well-founded assumptions rather than padded safety factors.
 Lightweight Optimization: Drive topology and parametric optimization to minimize mass within the safety margin, validated by physical testing.
 Dynamic & Fatigue Analysis: Model impact, vibration and cyclic loading to predict failure modes before they appear in testing.
 Design Collaboration: Partner with the design engineers from the earliest concept stage, turning simulation insight into load-path-aligned design decisions rather than after-the-fact checks.
 Methods & Standards: Establish the organization's FEA methods, material data and sign-off standards, and correlate them continuously with test results.
 Your profile 
 We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.
 Must-haves 
 Experience: 5+ years of dedicated FEA/structural simulation in high-performance robotics, aerospace or automotive engineering, with a track record of sign-offs on structures that shipped.
 FEA Mastery: Expert level in Abaqus or comparable tools for static, dynamic, modal and fatigue analysis - able to defend every modeling assumption behind a sign-off.
 Materials & Methods: Solid knowledge of metals and composites, topology optimization and multi-body dynamics.
 Test Correlation: Proven experience correlating simulation predictions with physical test data.
 CAD Fluency: Comfortable in CAD to translate findings directly into design iterations.
 Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You bridge mechanical, electrical and software teams, and you iterate until predicted and measured failure modes match.
 Nice-to-haves 
 Explicit Dynamics: Experience with drop and impact simulation.
 Thermal-Structural Coupling: Experience combining thermal and structural results.
 Scripting & Automation: Python or similar to automate pre- and post-processing.
 Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.
 Why us? 
 The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.
 Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.
 Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.
 Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
 About us 
 We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
 Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, We fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
 Our Locations 
 We have two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all builders.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a 
 Software Simulation Engineer (d/f/m) 
 As part of the Future Capabilities Simulation team in Germany, you are not just developing simulators —you are developing the platforms of the future. Our mission is centered on pushing the boundaries of what is possible in aerospace simulation, beyond usual R&D. We focus on "Next-Gen" capabilities, exploring how emerging technologies can redefine training and engineering environments. 
 You will work in a high-autonomy R&D environment, moving from theoretical concepts to functional, high-fidelity, distributed real-time applications. This role is designed for a "Full-Stack" Engineer: someone who is as comfortable designing a low-level C++ physics model as they are in architecting a cloud-native deployment pipeline or a distributed network protocol. 
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. 
 Your location 
 Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Contribute to the architectural design of next-generation software components, moving from "proof of concept" to scalable, production-ready simulation frameworks. 
 Develop complex, high-performance simulation models (C++) and the supporting software ecosystem. 
 Develop the communication layers for distributed real-time applications, ensuring low-latency data exchange across complex networks. 
 Build and maintain modern CI/CD pipelines and leverage virtualization (Containers/VMs) to ensure seamless deployment across diverse hardware environments. 
 Create sophisticated developer tools, including code generators and automated testing frameworks, to accelerate the R&D lifecycle. 
 Actively participate in the full lifecycle —from requirements engineering to integration and acceptance testing— using modern Processes, Methods and Tools (PMT) and agile methodologies. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 
 3+ years of proven professional experience in the Industry, in a complex software environment, with a strong focus on simulation or real-time systems. 
 Expert C++: Deep understanding of modern C++ (C++17/20), memory management, and real-time constraints. 
 Proficiency in Python for automation, data analysis, and tool development. 
 Experience with Qt/QML for interfaces or Go for backend services is a plus. 
 Proven ability to design modular, extensible, and maintainable software architectures. 
 Strong grasp of networking protocols essential for distributed real-time systems. 
 Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or Virtual Machines to manage simulation environments is desired. 
 Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.) is desired. 
 Mastery of Git and experience working in distributed teams using modern collaboration tools (Jira, Confluence, etc.). 
 A "test-first" mindset, with experience in Unit, Integration, and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) as well as Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing. 
 Proactive attitude is an absolute must. 
 Fluency in English. German and/or Spanish are a plus. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

About us 
 At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. 
 Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄  
 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.
 Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.
 We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.
 Introducing the Trainline Railcard Retention & Loyalty Team 👋 
 Millions of customers rely on Trainline to make rail travel simpler, and Railcards play a big part in that experience, helping people save money and travel more often. The Retention & Loyalty team is responsible for the features and experiences that keep customers engaged with their Railcards on the Trainline app, from renewal journeys to loyalty incentives that make rail travel feel more rewarding over time.
 As a Mid-Level Web Engineer, you’ll work closely with product, design and data colleagues to build and improve the web experiences that support Railcard renewal and loyalty, taking ownership of your work from initial development through to release and ongoing monitoring. You’ll also help shape how the team approaches new features and experiments, contributing ideas as well as code.
 In this role as the Mid-Level Web Engineer, you will... 🚄 
 Build and ship new features and improvements to the Railcard experience on the Trainline app, using React and TypeScript to create reliable, maintainable interfaces
 Work with GraphQL and Node.js to connect front-end features to the services and data that power Railcard retention and loyalty
 Take ownership of your work across the full development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring on AWS
 Keep quality at the heart of everything you do, with a strong focus on testing and continuous improvement of the codebase
 Keep the customer at the centre of every decision, understanding how changes affect their experience
 Use A/B testing to explore different approaches and identify the most valuable solution for customers
 Collaborate with product, design and other engineering teams to deliver work that fits into the wider Trainline app
 We’d love to hear from you if you have... 🔍 
 Good hands-on experience with React and TypeScript, and enjoy building well-tested, reliable features
 Experience working across the development lifecycle, from writing code through to deployment and monitoring
 Strong testing practices and a genuine focus on quality in your work
 Great communication skills and enjoy working within a collaborative, agile team
 A proactive, supportive and honest approach to working as part of a close-knit team
 Ideally some exposure to GraphQL, Node.js or AWS, or are keen to build experience with them
 A curiosity for learning new skills and approaches as technology evolves
 More information: 
 Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits. 
 We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one! 
 We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.
 Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do: 
 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail 
 ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey 
 🤝  Travel Together - We're one team 
 ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact 
 We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.
 Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn , Instagram and Glassdoor ! 
 Compensation: £60K – £70K
