Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! 
 Jouw rol 
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).
 Jouw werkzaamheden 
 In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.
 Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.
 Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).
 Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.
 Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.
 Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland 
 Wie zijn wij? 
Heras is Europa's toonaangevende aanbieder van 360° beveiligingsoplossingen, gespecialiseerd in perimeter- en technische beveiliging om te beschermen wat belangrijk is. We ontwerpen, installeren en onderhouden complete beveiligingssystemen die naadloos aansluiten op de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten. Zo beschermen we mensen, locaties en kritieke infrastructuur. Gedreven door onze visie om de wereld veiliger te maken, zetten wij ons in voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor mens en milieu. Met meer dan 3.200 medewerkers ondersteunen wij klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en landen. Als betrouwbare partner zijn wij één aanspreekpunt voor alle beveiligingsvraagstukken, en houden wij jouw wereld veilig.
 Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
 Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Bronzen Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 35% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/ 
 Jouw profiel 
 Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance)
 Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding
 Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data
 Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate
 Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk
 Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst
 Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen
 Wat bieden wij jou? 
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende:
 Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime
 2 verlofdagen per maand
 Flexibiliteit en vrijheid
 Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis
 Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras
 Iets voor jou? 
Als je graag meer informatie wil ontvangen over de vacature of sollicitatieprocedure neem dan contact op met onze Corporate Recruiter Bram Smits via 0629148655.
 Voor externe partijen: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Heras behoudt hiermee het recht om ingestuurde kandidaten rechtstreeks te benaderen.

About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Every change to Anthropic's software has to reach production somehow: new code, runtime configuration, feature flags, infrastructure changes. Our team builds the systems those changes travel through. Our mission is to give every team at Anthropic a fast, safe, and predictable path from change to production.
 You'll join the team within Anthropic's Infrastructure organization that owns pipelines, staged rollouts, health-gated promotion, and rollback, along with runtime configuration, feature flags, and the systems that deliver code and artifacts to machines across a very large fleet. You'll own a meaningful part of this end to end, from design through operating it in production.
 If you want your work to shape how fast and how safely Anthropic ships, this could be a great fit.
 Key responsibilities
 Set technical direction for major parts of the deployment platform and own them end to end: design, implementation, operations, and on-call
 Build rollout safety into the platform, including progressive delivery, health-gated promotion, automatic pause and rollback, and deploy controls that teams manage themselves
 Design APIs and abstractions that work equally well for engineers and for AI agents
 Extend the platform to new workload types and runtimes, from Kubernetes to serverless and edge platforms
 Build and operate runtime configuration and feature flag systems with validation, gradual rollout, and fast rollback
 Build infrastructure-as-code workflows that many teams rely on for safe, routine changes
 Scale artifact distribution so code and configuration reach machines quickly and efficiently
 Partner with Security so that the path to production is secure by default, with verifiable builds, least-privilege access, and auditable changes
 Work directly with teams across Anthropic to understand their deployment needs and bring their workloads onto the platform
 Take part in on-call and incident response, and turn what you learn into guardrails so the same problem can't recur
 Minimum qualifications
 Proficiency in at least one backend or systems programming language, such as Rust, Go, C++, or Java
 Experience leading the design, building, and operation of distributed systems or infrastructure in production, including technical direction across teams
 Experience with cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads, such as Kubernetes on AWS or GCP
 Strong written and verbal communication skills
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience building deployment, release, or change management systems at large scale
 Experience with production on-call and incident response
 Experience with Rust in production
 Experience with progressive delivery and GitOps tooling, such as Argo CD or Argo Rollouts
 Deep knowledge of Kubernetes, including controllers and operators
 Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code systems at scale, including state management and locking
 Experience building feature flag, experimentation, or dynamic configuration systems
 Experience with artifact or package distribution, such as OCI registries, Nix, or content-addressed storage
 Experience with software supply chain security, such as signed build provenance
 Experience building high-throughput workflow engines or control planes backed by relational databases
 Experience building internal developer platforms and driving adoption across many teams
 Experience using AI agents in your own engineering work, or building systems that agents operate
 Representative projects
 Build operator controls for progressive rollouts, including pause and resume that preserve rollout state
 Design a deployment engine built on fine-grained targets and their dependencies, so each change rolls out exactly where it needs to
 Build cluster-health-aware rollouts that steer around unhealthy clusters
 Add a new workload type to the platform, including its rollout, verification, and rollback behavior
 Design a deployment control plane that handles sharp bursts of agent-driven traffic
 Design a distribution system that delivers configuration and artifacts to every machine in the fleet as demand grows

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.jobDescription:
Our Mission
 At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
 We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!
 The Role
 You will build the parts of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world, where field data is the input. LEA takes in cameras, infrared, thermal, lidar and robot state natively, around the clock, on real security sites. We stand on the best open models for the encoders and the reasoning head and do not pretrain from scratch. Your work goes where nobody else can do it: fusing every sensor into one stream, teaching an open vision-language model to reason over that stream, and distilling a fast model that sees every frame.
 This is the first engineer dedicated to the model track, so you will also set how we train, evaluate and ship models. You will work with our Command Centre and Robot Autonomy teams to get what you train running on site appliances and robots, and you will see it tested at 03:00 in the rain.
 What You'll Work On
 Native encoders: adapt the best open vision and point-cloud foundation models to RGB, IR, thermal and lidar, one encoder per sensor, raw stream in.
 Fusion: build the layer that aligns every sensor in time and space into one token stream, trained on time-aligned multi-sensor field data that exists nowhere else.
 Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures.
 Fast head: distil a small model from the slow head's calls on our own events, so every frame is seen and only hard cases escalate.
 Evaluation: held-out sites, night and thermal slices, regression gates. A model that is worse anywhere does not ship.
 Training machinery: multi-GPU training, data loaders for multi-sensor clips, experiment tracking and reproducible runs.
 Who We're Looking For
 A research engineer who has shipped multimodal models, not only published them. You know when an open model is good enough and when to build, you measure on the slice that matters before claiming a number, and you care whether the model works on a real site, not only on a benchmark.
 Your Background
 4+ years training and fine-tuning large vision or multimodal models, or a PhD plus industry experience.
 Strong PyTorch, comfortable with multi-GPU and multi-node training.
 Hands-on fine-tuning of vision-language models (instruction tuning, parameter-efficient methods, full fine-tunes).
 Experience with knowledge distillation or model compression for deployment.
 Work with video or non-RGB sensors: thermal, infrared, lidar or radar.
 Evaluation discipline and solid software engineering hygiene.
 Nice to Have
 Point-cloud or 3D foundation models.
 Self-supervised and latent-prediction methods (JEPA-style).
 Edge deployment with TensorRT or similar.
 Robotics or field data collection.
 Publications at top ML, vision or robotics venues.
 What We Offer
 Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
 Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
 Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
 Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.
 Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package
 Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

 Dabei arbeitest du sowohl an der Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP und Joomla als auch an der Umsetzung moderner, responsiver Benutzeroberflächen.
 Deine Aufgaben

 Sehr gute PHP-Kenntnisse: Du beherrschst PHP sicher und verfügst über Erfahrung in der objektorientierten Programmierung sowie im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, insbesondere MySQL/MariaDB.

### Minimum qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience in addressing customers from the automotive or manufacturing industries.
* Experience in sales, consulting or project management.

* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).

* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.

## About the Job
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. 
Germany: €112000 - €114000 (EUR) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers, continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

The opportunity
 The R&D Test Engineer for high-voltage products (main focus: gas-insulated switchgear and hydromechanical operating mechanisms) is responsible for planning, executing, and analyzing tests in our laboratory in Karlstein am Main, ensuring that products meet defined design requirements.
This role requires close collaboration with global R&D teams to develop test protocols and ensure quality assurance throughout the entire product development lifecycle.
 How You'll Make An Impact
 Plan and execute test activities, including defining test plans, timelines, and required resources
 Assemble, modify, and prepare test objects and laboratory test setups for testing activities
 Perform tests independently and ensure reliable, accurate, and reproducible results
 Analyze test results, conduct root cause investigations, and support technical problem-solving activities
 Coordinate and monitor internal and external testing, ensuring alignment on quality, progress, and budget
 Ensure proper maintenance, calibration, and readiness of test equipment, tools, and laboratory facilities
 Prepare and maintain technical test documentation and communicate results to relevant stakeholders
 Identify and implement improvements in testing methods, tools, and processes while supporting certification activities and compliance with applicable standards
 Your background
 Degree in Engineering, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
 0-2 years of experience in research and development, testing, or a comparable industrial environment
 Hands-on experience in assembling, modifying, or maintaining mechanical, hydraulic, or electromechanical systems is highly desirable
 Interest in practical engineering work and working with laboratory equipment, mechanical assemblies, and oil-filled high-voltage components
 Basic understanding of relevant technical fundamentals in the field

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment
 More About Us
 The opportunity to shape your role in a growing market and dynamic work environment
 Attractive compensation in line with IG Metall standards, including:
 30 days of vacation
 Holiday and Christmas pay
 Structured onboarding with dedicated support
 Employer-funded pension scheme and retirement benefits
 Family-friendly benefits, including holiday childcare programs and childcare support

 Exciting career growth and professional development opportunities

Your mission 
 As an Actuator Mechanical Engineer, you join the early team and own the actuators of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance. Actuators are the muscles of the robot: they turn energy into precise, human-like motion, cycle after cycle. Whatever your background in robotics, aerospace or automotive, you bring deep expertise in power-dense mechanical design, and you take pride in drives that perform on the test bench and in the field.
 Key responsibilities 
 Actuator Architecture: Lead the mechanical design of high-torque linear and rotary actuators - from concept to production-ready CAD - optimizing for power density, efficiency and compact assembly.
 Drive Integration: Select and integrate motors, encoders, gears and bearings into robust, serviceable actuator units, and define their interfaces together with the adjacent engineering teams.
 Engineering Analysis: Back every design with sound calculations and first-pass simulation, and work closely with our simulation engineers on detailed structural and thermal sign-offs.
 Validation: Define and run test protocols - including performance, vibration and accelerated life testing - and feed the results straight back into the design.
 DFM/DFA Excellence: Design every component for manufacturability and assembly at scale from day one, working closely with the workshop, suppliers and supply chain to eliminate late-stage redesigns.
 Your profile 
 We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.
 Experience: 5+ years in actuator or drivetrain development in high-performance robotics, aerospace, automotive or similar high-tech industries. A proven track record of shipping complex hardware products is essential.
 Mastery of CAD: Expert level in CAD, including complex assemblies and production drawings with GD&T.
 Mechanical Fundamentals: Deep, first-principles command of classical mechanics, machine elements and tribology - gears, bearings, seals, lubrication and fatigue.
 Drive Components: Proven experience selecting and integrating BLDC motors, encoders, gearboxes and precision bearings.
 DFM/DFA Proficiency: Strong command of design for series production, focusing on manufacturing-driven design optimization, parts reduction, assembly-friendly tolerancing and cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) reduction.
 Mindset: You balance startup agility with the rigor of industrial-grade engineering. You enjoy troubleshooting prototypes and refining designs on test data - and you design for the loads, heat and wear an actuator faces in real operation.
 Nice-to-haves 
 Simulation: Hands-on experience with FEA and CFD for structural and thermal analysis.
 Thermal Management: A good understanding of cooling concepts for motors and drive electronics.
 Test Benches: Experience designing actuator test rigs and data acquisition setups.
 Robotics Fundamentals: Working understanding of humanoid and/or industrial robotics systems - how perception, actuation and control interact.
 Why us? 
 The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards.
 Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations.
 Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission.
 Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market.
 About us 
 We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.
 Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, We fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.
 Our Locations 
 We have two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all builders.

items.jobTitle: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Ads Foundational Representations
items.jobDescription:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . 
 Location: Reddit has a flexible first workforce. Don't live near our office? No worries: you can work remotely from anywhere in the UK or the Netherlands.
 The Ads Foundational Representations (AFR) team develops signals and representations of Reddit’s core entities (ads, posts, users, and so on), capturing the semantic, contextual, and behavioral information that Reddit Ads needs. We work on building embeddings to understand content and users' interests based on the content they engage with. 
 Our team has the potential to highlight one of Reddit's biggest differentiators: genuinely curated, high-quality, extremely relevant, and daily updated organic content. We are a Machine Learning/Data heavy team with a focus on the following areas:
 Multimodal & Content Embeddings - Make sense of organic (posts, comments, subreddits) and promoted (ads, shopping products, their landing pages) text and media content by embedding them into a shared space. 
 Contextual and Behavioral Relevance - Working with Product & Data Science, establishing definitions of what ads are relevant to users and the content we show them next to, building metrics and fine-tuning embeddings to better reflect relevance.
 Knowledge Graph Embeddings - Building representations for the Knowledge graph entities, e.g., intellectual properties/brands, to be used for high-precision targeting & business insights. 
 User Intent Modeling - Leveraging various techniques to introduce user representations based on the content they interact with: batch & real-time sequence modeling, LLM summarization, etc. 
 LLM-based Representations - Leveraging LLMs, VLMs, and foundational models to build complex representations of Reddit entities that improve ranking outcomes
 The signals and features we create become a key piece in the Ads Delivery funnel, from targeting to the auction, as well as the Business Insights product and other advertiser-facing products such as Creative generation and optimization.
 As a Staff ML Engineer , you’ll be in charge of setting the technical direction of multiple pillars the team owns. You will lead cross-functional ML projects end to end - from high-level business gap analysis to engineering execution. 
 Roughly 50% of your time will be spent on technical leadership and mentorship (driving strategy & designs, cross-functional collaboration, raising the quality bar), another 50% being individual hands-on work (data analysis & engineering, modeling & automation).  
 Responsibilities 
 Providing technical leadership and mentorship to MLEs in the team: driving designs & their review, establishing best practices in analysis, modeling and engineering, keeping the bar high. 
 Working closely with team/org leadership developing technical strategy for content-based embeddings & relevance for Ads.
 Developing new or iterating on existing embedding models for advertising use cases, ranging from aggregation pipelines to two-tower architectures and sequence models.  
 Working with local and 3rd-party LLMs/VLMs: extract representations, develop evaluation methodologies, prompt tune and fine-tune large models to build state-of-the-art embeddings. 
 Building data processing and inference pipelines for the models we develop. 
 Qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the various features we develop, end-to-end experimentation from internal benchmarks to downstream recommender system offline metrics to online experiments. 
 Ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of the ML systems by writing automated tests, monitoring performance, and implementing best practices for model management.
 Participating in modeling and coding reviews: You will review work by other team members and provide feedback to ensure that it meets the team's standards for quality and performance.
 Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
 Required Qualifications: 
 7+ years of hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of designing, training, evaluating, testing, and deploying industry-level models.
 Demonstrated Staff-level technical leadership: mentoring engineers, driving standards and bar raising, leading complex cross-functional projects: from requirements, design to cross-team/functional alignment and execution without direct people-management authority. 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts to different audiences, both verbally and in writing. 
 Strong track record of working on content rich NLP/CV problems at scale, and using embeddings as a tool to solve them. 
 Established data-driven approach for ML system development. Excitement about working with data and readiness to look behind the metric numbers. 
 Familiarity with the Ads domain and/or Search/Recommender systems.
 Experience with mainstream DL frameworks: PyTorch or TensorFlow.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with our stack (Python, Pytorch, Airflow, BigQuery, Ray, k8s, kafka, GCP)
 Tech leadership experience: mentoring junior engineers and leading complex projects. 
 Hands-on experience with using/fine-tuning/building LLMs.
 Benefits: 
 Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
 Family Planning Support
 Gender-Affirming Care
 Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
 Private Pension plan with Employer-matching
 100% employer-sponsored group medical plan  
 Income Replacement Programs
 Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
 Generous Paid Parental Leave
 In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.
 During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . 
 Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

Join Instil's agentic product development team in 2027 and learn to build software the way it will be built in the agentic age: engineers owning the problem, the architecture and the key decisions, with AI agents accelerating everything in between.

 At Instil, agentic product engineering is how we deliver. Our teams work alongside an agentic workforce that generates requirements, builds across parallel workstreams, runs continuous quality and security checks or monitoring systems in production. The result is software that ships faster, with lower risk.
 The agents do a lot, but people stay firmly in charge - orchestrating. We own the problem, the architecture and the key decisions. That is the skill set we will help you build from day one.
 As a graduate you will join a delivery team working on real client products for organisations ranging from ambitious start-ups to global brands. You will learn the fundamentals of great software engineering and, alongside them, how to direct, review and get the best out of AI agents.

 Real client work from your first months, not just internal projects

 LKQ DACH mit Sitz in Poing bei München ist einer der Hauptakteure im Pkw-Teile-Großhandel in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz und an über 150 Standorten vertreten. Zu LKQ DACH gehören die Stahlgruber GmbH in Poing bei München, die PV Automotive GmbH, die Stahlgruber Gesellschaft m.b.H. in Wals bei Salzburg, Österreich, die Neimcke GmbH & Co. KG in Mühldorf am Inn sowie die Rhiag Group GmbH in Zug, Schweiz. LKQ DACH ist Teil von LKQ Europe mit Sitz in Zug, Schweiz.
Als SAP Key User & HR Systemadministrator (m/w/d) gestalten Sie aktiv die Weiterentwicklung unserer HR-Systemlandschaft. Sie sind zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen HR, Payroll, IT und externen Dienstleistern und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung unserer Personalprozesse voran.
 #Aufgaben
 Betreuung, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von SAP SuccessFactors (Employee Central & Employee Central Payroll)

Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand. 
 As a Clinical Data Systems & Data Management Lead , you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, integrity, security, and accessibility of clinical trial data. You will act as the bridge between Clinical Operations, Data Management, IT, and Quality teams while supporting the deployment, administration, and evolution of clinical research systems.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Provide methodological and technical support for the design and deployment of clinical data collection tools (eCRF).
 Administer clinical research systems, including eTMF, CTMS, GED/QMS, TRMS, and other business applications.
 Manage interfaces and APIs between key clinical systems to ensure seamless data flow.
 Oversee the storage, archiving, security, and integrity of clinical study databases.
 Contribute to the definition and deployment of the organization's Data Management strategy.
 Ensure compliance with GCP, GDPR
 Participate in SOP development, user training, and support activities.
 Drive digitalization and continuous improvement initiatives within clinical research operations.
 Requirements 
 Education 
 Master's degree in Data Science, Biostatistics, Computer Science, Data Management, Life Sciences, or a related field. 
 Experience 
 Significant experience in Clinical Data Management and/or administration of computerized clinical systems.
 Technical Skills 
 Strong understanding of clinical trial data management processes and clinical research environments.
 Experience with clinical systems such as eTMF, CTMS, eCRF, GED/QMS, or related platforms.
 Knowledge of Ennov Clinical and/or REDCap is a plus.
 Familiarity with SAS, R, SPSS, or other statistical tools is advantageous.
 Understanding of GCP, GDPR, and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements.
 Languages 
 Professional proficiency in English.
 Benefits 
 Why Join Us?
 At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with a true team spirit to redefine excellence in the healthcare sector.
 Here’s what sets us apart:
 We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, with the goal of becoming the leading mid-size CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience. Our “one-stop provider” model—offering full-service, FSP, and consulting—allows you to grow through a variety of projects. Working alongside recognized experts, you’ll contribute to the advancement of scientific, operational, and interpersonal knowledge, all in the service of improving the patient experience.
 “Excelling with care” means thriving in an environment that values your natural talents, encourages boldness, and supports the development of your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our collective mission.

items.jobDescription:
Das Max-Planck-Institut für molekulare Genetik ist ein internationales Forschungsinstitut im Bereich der medizinischen Genomforschung. Es beschäftigt ungefähr 350 Mitarbeiter*innen.
Sein For­schungsschwerpunkt liegt auf der Untersuchung der Funktion und Regulation des Genoms während der Embryonalentwicklung und bei der Entstehung von Krankheiten.
 Für unsere Administration suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt zunächst befristet für ein Jahr im Umfang von ca. 20 Wochenstunden
 eine*n Mitarbeiter*in No-Code-Anwendungsentwicklung und Prozessdigitalisierung (m/w/d) 
 Vergütung je nach Qualifikation bis zur Entgeltgruppe 9b TVöD-Bund 
 (bei laufendem Masterstudium ggf. als studentische Beschäftigung) 
 Die Position ist in ein enges, kollegiales Arbeitssetting eingebunden: Sie arbeiten insbesondere sehr eng mit den Fachverantwortlichen zusammen, die unser derzeitiges Digitalisierungsprojekt inhaltlich und anwendungstechnisch verantworten. In dieser Zusammenarbeit verstehen wir die Rolle ausdrücklich als fachlichtechnisches Sparring. Während auf bestehender Seite bereits fachliche und anwendungsnahe Kompetenz vorhanden ist, wünschen wir uns mit dieser Position eine Ergänzung um eine stärker IT-, skript- und schnittstellenaffine Perspektive. Dabei arbeiten wir strukturiert und verlässlich zusammen und schaffen gleichzeitig Raum für kreative Lösungsansätze, neue Ideen und Freude an guter gemeinsamer Arbeit.
 Diese Aufgaben erwarten Sie
 Sie arbeiten eng mit den Fachverantwortlichen zusammen und bringen Ihre IT-/Skript-Affinität als ergänzende Perspektive in die gemeinsame Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen ein.
 Sie konzipieren, erstellen und betreuen Anwendungen auf Basis einer No-Code-/Low-Code-Plattform, insbesondere SeaTable oder einer vergleichbaren Software.
 Sie setzen Anforderungen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen in praxistaugliche digitale Lösungen um, z. B. aus der Administration, dem Personalbereich, der Arbeitssicherheit sowie wissenschaftlichen Serviceeinheiten.
 Sie entwickeln im Team bestehende Anwendungen weiter und sichern die Qualität bereits aufgebauter Lösungen.
 Sie binden bei Bedarf Schnittstellen über APIs ein und erstellen kleinere Skripte, insbesondere in Python oder JavaScript.
 Sie dokumentieren Anwendungen, Konfigurationen und Logiken nachvollziehbar und erstellen dazu Anleitungen
 Wir wünschen uns von Ihnen
 Sie haben ein Hochschulstudium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Verwaltungsinformatik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang mit einem Bachelor erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder befinden sich in einem entsprechenden Masterstudium oder verfügen über vergleichbare Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse.
 Sie haben idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in der Umsetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in digitalen Anwendungen, vorzugsweise auf No-Code-/Low-Code-Plattformen wie SeaTable, Airtable oder einer vergleichbaren Software.
 Sie verfügen über Kenntnisse in Python oder JavaScript und können kleinere Skripte erstellen oder anpassen, insbesondere zur Nutzung von APIs oder zur Automatisierung von Abläufen.
 Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis für digitale Systeme und Prozesse und behalten zugleich die praktische Anwendbarkeit im Arbeitsalltag im Blick.
 Sie arbeiten strukturiert, sorgfältig und qualitätsorientiert.
 Sie können technische Konfigurationen und Abläufe verständlich dokumentieren und schriftlich nachvollziehbar festhalten.
 Sie stehen dem Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen offen gegenüber und nutzen diese verantwortungsvoll, strukturiert und nachvollziehbar.
 Sie arbeiten teamorientiert, bringen sich gern in eine enge kollegiale Zusammenarbeit ein und können dem Arbeitsanfall entsprechend priorisieren.
 Sie haben Freude daran, tragfähige Lösungen gemeinsam zu entwickeln, und bewegen sich sicher in einem Arbeitsumfeld, das Struktur mit Gestaltungsspielraum verbindet.
 Für eine gute Zusammenarbeit mit unserer vielfältigen Belegschaft wünschen wir uns von Ihnen ein hohes Maß an interkultureller Offenheit und Kompetenz.
 Ihre Sprachkenntnisse in Englisch entsprechen mindestens dem Niveau B2, in Deutsch kommunizieren Sie auf dem Niveau C1 gemäß Europäischem Referenzrahmen.
 Wir bieten Ihnen
 Wir bieten Ihnen einen Arbeitsplatz in einem modernen und freundlichen Arbeitsumfeld, eine hervorragende Infrastruktur inklusive umfangreicher Hardwareausstattung für das Mobile Office, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben sowie die Möglichkeit, Neues auszuprobieren. Sie erwartet eine sehr kollegiale Zusammenarbeit mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen, klarer gemeinsamer Zielorientierung und gleichzeitig Raum für kreative Gestaltung. Uns ist wichtig, dass gute Arbeit in einem Umfeld entsteht, das verlässlich, respektvoll und menschlich ist — und in dem die Zusammenarbeit auch Freude macht.
 Für eine gute Work-Life-Balance können Sie bei uns am Institut im Rahmen der Gleitzeit Ihre Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten und nach der Einarbeitungszeit nach Absprache mobil arbeiten. Ihre berufliche Entwicklung unterstützen wir mit einem umfangreichen internen Fortbildungsangebot.
 Das Entgelt richtet sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD Bund). Daneben werden Sozialleistungen entsprechend den Regelungen für den öffentlichen Dienst gewährt (VBL, Kitaplatzkontingente, Zuschuss zum Jobticket).
 Je nach Qualifikation ist eine Beschäftigung bis zur Entgeltgruppe 9b TVöD-Bund möglich. Ohne abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium erfolgt die Eingruppierung entsprechend eine Entgeltgruppe darunter. Bei einem laufenden Masterstudium kann die Beschäftigung im Rahmen einer studentischen Tätigkeit erfolgen.
 Haben Sie Fragen? Unsere Verwaltungsleiterin Dr. Claudia Thurow beantwortet sie gerne unter thurow@molgen.mpg.de .
 Die Max-Planck-Gesellschaft hat sich zum Ziel gesetzt, mehr schwerbehinderte Menschen zu beschäftigen. Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter Menschen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.
 Die Max-Planck-Gesellschaft strebt nach Geschlechtergerechtigkeit und Vielfalt. Ferner möchte die Max-Planck-Gesellschaft den Anteil von Frauen in den Bereichen erhöhen, in de­nen sie unterrepräsentiert sind. Frauen werden deshalb ausdrücklich aufgefordert, sich zu bewerben.
 Ihre Bewerbung
 Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung mit aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inklusive relevanter Zeugnisse / Arbeitszeugnisse) bis zum 03.01.2027 . Erste Vorstellungsgespräche finden ggf. schon vor Ablauf der Bewerbungsfrist statt. Wir bitten Sie, bei Ihrer Bewerbung auf ein Bewerbungsfoto zu verzichten und freuen uns ausdrücklich über Ihre Bewerbung, auch wenn Sie das Stellenprofil nicht komplett ausfüllen, über unser Bewerbungsmanagementsystem .

About Us
 Batteries are a key element of our clean energy and mobility future. ACCURE makes batteries safe, reliable, and sustainable through the power of the cloud. Using our highly scalable monitoring and optimization platform, we drastically improve the performance of batteries in grid storage systems around the world.
Our mission: Safe, efficient, and sustainable batteries for a clean energy future.
To do this, we need passionate builders and storytellers. At ACCURE, people with diverse backgrounds work together on our common vision of a clean energy future. We value passion and humbleness and are looking for highly motivated individuals to join our fast-growing international team.
 Your Role
 Own your customer portfolio: Be the single point of contact for several European grid-scale BESS customers at once. You own each relationship end to end and are accountable for customer health and the value they get from ACCURE.
 Think like an asset manager: Understand each customer’s business case, including availability, warranty and LTSA claims, augmentation and revenue. Make sure our insights improve those numbers.
 Turn insight into action: Interpret results from our Predictive Battery Analytics Platform, decide what matters, and turn findings into clear recommendations that shape customers’ operating decisions.
 Bridge between customer and team: Act as the main interface between our customers and ACCURE’s analytics and engineering teams. Bring customer priorities into the team and make sure our customers get fast, well-founded answers.
 Shape the roadmap: Feed what you learn in the field back to product and engineering.
 Your Skills
 BESS industry experience: 3+ years in the BESS or energy storage industry, ideally in asset management (owner, IPP, asset manager or O&M). You know how a storage portfolio is operated and how it earns money.
 Customer ownership: 2+ years managing several customer accounts in parallel as the accountable relationship owner, in technical account management, customer success, consulting or a similar role.
 Project management: You run several customer projects in parallel, such as onboardings, investigations and deliverables, keeping scope, timelines and stakeholders on track from start to finish.
 Battery expertise: A solid understanding of lithium-ion behavior, degradation and safety in grid storage.
 Analytical and diagnostic: You can interpret analytics, dig into complex technical problems, explain root causes clearly and link them to business outcomes.
 International collaboration: Experience working with remote or international teams. You’re comfortable representing the customer internally and aligning across time zones.
 Communication: You present confidently in English to operators and executives alike.
 Location: You’re based in and have a valid work permit in one of the following countries: Germany, the UK, Spain, Estonia or the Netherlands.
 Our Offer
 Impact: Significant impact on product direction at a pivotal stage in the company's commercial model.
 Work-life balance: Trust-based, flexible working hours and generous paid time off.
 Compensation: Performance-based compensation plan (range depending on experience level).
 Company events: Two 5-day company onsites per year.
 Green future: A job that shapes the future and turns our planet greener one battery at a time.

items.jobDescription:
Why Mozilla? 
 Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.  
 The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.  
 About this team and role: 
 The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.” 
 As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems. 
 What you’ll do:  
 Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector. 
 Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping. 
 Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve. 
 Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved. 
 Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine. 
 Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices. 
 Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams. 
 Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development. 
 What you’ll bring:  
 5+ years developing C++ applications 
 Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines 
 Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software 
 Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.) 
 A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help 
 Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards 
 Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers 
 Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow 
 What you’ll get: 
 Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team 
 Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage 
 Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) 
 Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together 
 Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday 
 One-time home office stipend 
 Annual professional development budget 
 Quarterly well-being stipend 
 Considerable paid parental leave 
 Employee referral bonus program 
 Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country) 
 About Mozilla  
 Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.
 Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 
 Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.
 We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at We are an equal opportunity employer. items.jobTitle: Forward Deployed Engineer – Key Accounts (AI Solutions)
items.jobDescription:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.
For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.
We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.
Come join us!
You'll be the technical partner for a portfolio of Aircall's strategic global accounts, working closely with Key Account Managers to drive agentic AI adoption use case by use case, from the first deployed use case to broader expansion.
 About The Team
 Aircall's Forward Deployed Engineering team connects our innovative AI Agents technology to real-world customer workflows. We turn possibility into production by delivering automation that improves customer experience, boosts productivity, and unlocks new business value. Working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions, and Customer Success, the team ensures every deployment delivers measurable impact.
Within that team, this is a hands-on, Key Accounts–focused role for someone who wants to go deep rather than broad, working with a portfolio of Aircall's strategic customers and growing agentic adoption inside each one over time. It sits at the intersection of technical consulting, project delivery, and AI adoption. You don't need to be a full-time software engineer, but you should be fluent in APIs, confident managing technical projects, and comfortable working with customer stakeholders.
 About The Role
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer for Key Accounts, you are the technical point of contact for a portfolio of Aircall's strategic customers. You don't run a deployment and move on. You stay with the account and help build its agentic roadmap alongside the Key Account Manager (KAM).
You help land a first high-impact use case, prove value fast, then expand the footprint use case by use case. You'll work closely with the KAM, senior FDEs, Product, and Engineering, taking on increasing ownership of your accounts as you grow in the role.
Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue-driving role spanning Solutions Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership.
 What You'll Do
 Build ongoing relationships with the accounts in your portfolio as their go-to technical contact for Aircall's AI Agents.
 Partner with the Key Account Manager on the account plan: the KAM owns the commercial relationship and quota. You own technical execution and contribute to the use-case roadmap and the pipeline of expansion opportunities.
 Deliver the first use case fast, then expand. Deploy an initial high-value workflow, track the outcome, and use proven value to identify the next use case.
 Run regular use-case discovery with customer teams to surface, qualify, and prioritise new automation opportunities.
 Act as a trusted advisor to your accounts on agentic AI. Help them build their AI roadmap 6–12 months out, not just the deployment in front of you, and keep Aircall positioned as their platform of choice.
 Lead discovery and solution-design sessions with customer stakeholders to map business processes, identify automation opportunities, and define solution architecture.
 Design, build, and deploy integrations using low/no-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation tools (HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow) with API connectors.
 Configure and optimise the AI Agent, defining intents, prompts, actions, guardrails, and performance metrics tailored to each account's workflows.
 Manage cross-functional deployments: define timelines, align stakeholders, ensure accountability, and deliver on time and within scope.
 Collaborate with Engineering to validate technical feasibility, resolve blockers, and share field learnings that inform product improvements.
 Create scalable models and reusable frameworks (templates, playbooks, reference architectures) that make expansion within Key Accounts faster and more consistent.
 Champion continuous learning and enablement. Train peers, run internal workshops, and document best practices to raise the technical bar across the team.
 Collaborate with GTM leadership on the routines and cadences that drive accountability for expansion pipeline, forecast accuracy, and performance tracking within Key Accounts.
 Contribute to expansion pipeline and MRR within your portfolio, jointly with the KAM.
 Share customer needs, integration insights, and field learnings with Product and PMM to help shape the AI Agent roadmap.
 Support internal and external product education, including enablement for System Integrators (SIs) and channel partners where they support your accounts.
 Maintain awareness of AI and CX industry trends, ensuring insights feed back into product and GTM strategy.
 What You'll Bring
 2–5 years of experience in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or integration-focused project management, ideally with some exposure to larger or enterprise accounts.
 Client-facing experience required, ideally working alongside sales or account management teams.
 Technical skills:
 Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL), with the ability to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.
 Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.
 Tools experience:
 Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).
 Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects, working with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating between technical and business audiences.
 A growth mindset: constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.
 Nice-to-haves:
 Experience in telephony, voice, or contact centre systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).
 Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).
 Exposure to scripting (JavaScript/Python) for light customisation and debugging.
 What Success Looks Like
 A growing number of live agentic use cases within each account in your portfolio.
 Shortened time-to-first-value on the initial use case, then a repeatable path to use case two and beyond.
 Contribution to net revenue retention and expansion MRR across your portfolio, jointly with the KAM.
 Strong, trusted working relationships with customer stakeholders.
 Reusable frameworks, models, and templates actively used by peers and partners.
 Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.
 Sustained improvements in customer metrics (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions.
 Why join us?
 🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
💶 Competitive salary package & benefits
 DE&I Statement
 At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.
We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.
We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.
 At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

Our Mission
 At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. About Codat 
 Codat is an advisory intelligence solution purpose-built for modern commercial banking. Through rich, specialized data, forward-looking insights, and integrated workflows, Codat empowers banking teams to deepen their relationships, grow their revenue, and simplify their day-to-day work.
 Founded in 2017 and backed by JPMorgan, PayPal, Amex, Plaid, and Shopify, Codat has successfully powered over 350,000 connections to business customers’ financial systems — and is trusted by industry leaders to turn scattered information into actionable, strategic advantages in real time, every time.
 The Role 
 Some of the biggest commercial banks in the world already work with us. Their relationship managers want to spend their time with clients, not digging through the books to find out what's changed. We're building the thing that does the digging for them.
 It's called the Advisory Intelligence Platform. It puts Codat's client intelligence inside the assistant a banker already uses, starting with Microsoft Copilot. Ask it anything about a client and it answers from that client's actual books. Don't ask, and it tells you anyway when something important changes.
 Every one of those answers sits on data. Someone has to get that data in, shape it, define it and serve it, so the number the assistant quotes is the right one. That's you. You write production software, and you care about the data it moves as much as the code that moves it.
 This role is for an engineer who's growing fast and wants room to grow faster. You'll ship from your first weeks, own what you build once it's live, and work alongside data and AI engineers who'll push you. Codat is AI-first, not AI bolted onto SaaS, and we work that way ourselves: agents take the repetitive work, engineers take the interesting problems.
 What You'll Work On 
 The data behind every answer. Services and pipelines that take raw data from accounting platforms, banks and payment systems and turn it into something a model can trust. When a source sends rubbish, your code notices.
 The semantic layer. The definitions the model is allowed to use: what counts as revenue, when a month ends, which currency. Get it right and every answer agrees with every other answer.
 The signal layer. Spotting when something changes for a client: a customer paying later, cash running tighter, a supplier quietly becoming critical. You'll help build the detection and make it fast and reliable.
 The tools the assistant calls. MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and APIs that serve data to agents. You'll build them, test them and find out how they break before a banker does.
 Keeping the numbers honest. Tests, data checks and observability that prove a number is right, and catch it the moment it isn't.
 You'll Probably Have 
 Shipped production software that real people depended on, and written most of it yourself. Services, APIs or data systems with tests, not notebooks or config.
 Had data be the hard part. A source that sent duplicates, a schema that changed under you, two teams who meant different things by "customer". You fixed it, and you'd design it differently now.
 Good engineering habits in Python, C# or another general-purpose language. Tested, modular code the next person can change without fear.
 An eye for SQL. You can read a query and tell whether it's right, whoever or whatever wrote it.
 Stayed on the hook for something after it went live. You found out why it broke, fixed the cause, and added what would have caught it sooner.
 Some time with CI/CD, Docker and cloud (we're on Azure). You've changed a pipeline, not just pushed to one.
 A habit of asking why. If someone asks for a number the data can't support, you say so.
 AI as part of how you work, and you can explain and defend what it helped you build.
 Momentum. More ownership with each move, new stacks picked up quickly, things built that nobody asked for.
 Useful, not essential: fintech, lending or accounting; Spark, Databricks or dbt; anything that puts data in front of an LLM.
 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We're more interested in what you've built and how fast you're growing than in a perfect match.
 How We Work 
 We're a small team with plenty to do. Things move fast: we'd rather ship something useful and improve it than polish it in private. What you build is yours from start to finish.
 There's no return-to-office mandate, and you can work hybrid or fully remote. We trust you to be around when the team needs you and to deliver what you said you would. What we don't want is anyone staying online late to prove a point.

Wenn es darum geht, zukünftig Millionen Fahrgäste und Tausende Züge auch digital auf den Weg zu bringen, braucht es die besten IT-Expert:innen. Über 10.000 haben wir schon, aber längst nicht genug. Als Projektleiter:in, Berater:in, Entwickler:in oder IT-Architekt:in ist jetzt die spannendste Zeit, um einzusteigen und in einem starken Team wegweisende Lösungen sowie Großprojekte in den Bereichen Mobilität, Infrastruktur und Logistik umzusetzen.
Als AI Solutions & Customer Success Engineer (w/m/d) bildest du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund und der Plattform GenAI Data Connect (GAIDC). GenAI Data Connect ist eine zentrale KI-Plattform der DB Systel, die Daten der Deutschen Bahn für Anwendungen mit generativer Künstlicher Intelligenz nutzbar macht. Die Plattform verbindet moderne Sprachmodelle mit internen Dokumenten und Wissensquellen und ermöglicht so die Generierung zuverlässiger, kontextbezogener Antworten auf Basis von DB-Daten. In deiner Rolle unterstützt du unsere Kund dabei, generative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich einzuführen und einzusetzen. Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und sorgst für einen reibungslosen Einstieg in die Nutzung unserer Plattform. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du die Weiterentwicklung von GAIDC aktiv mit, indem du Kundenfeedback in die Produktentwicklung einbringst und die Integration unternehmensinterner Daten in moderne KI-Anwendungen unterstützt.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als AI Solutions & Customer Success Engineer (w/m/d) für die DB Systel GmbH an den Standorten Berlin, Erfurt oder Frankfurt am Main.
Bei dieser Stelle besteht die Möglichkeit des hybriden Arbeitens. In Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft kannst du sowohl am festgelegten Bürostandort, als auch mobil an einem Ort deiner Wahl innerhalb Deutschlands tätig sein.
Deine Aufgaben:
 Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen von der ersten Erprobung über das Onboarding bis hin zur erfolgreichen Nutzung von GenAI Data Connect (GAIDC) und unterstützt sie dabei mit technischer Beratung und praxisnahen Lösungen
 In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertrieb präsentierst du technische Lösungen, analysierst Kundenanforderungen und zeigst auf, wie GAIDC zur Bewältigung konkreter geschäftlicher Herausforderungen beitragen kann
 Als zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kund:innen identifizierst du Herausforderungen und Verbesserungspotenziale, sammelst Feedback und leitest daraus konkrete Anforderungen für die Produktentwicklung und die technischen Teams ab
 Du erstellst Tutorials, Schulungsunterlagen, Best Practices und Kommunikationsmaterialien, um die Bekanntheit und Nutzung von GAIDC innerhalb des Konzerns zu fördern
 Dabei stellst du sicher, dass die technische Dokumentation korrekt, übersichtlich strukturiert, einheitlich verschlagwortet und stets aktuell ist
 Durch deine ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch baust du vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf und vermittelst technische sowie fachliche Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht
 Du konzipierst und implementierst skalierbare Lösungen zur Datenintegration innerhalb der Microsoft-Azure-Umgebung, um KI-basierte Anwendungsfälle und die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen zu ermöglichen
 Darüber hinaus konfigurierst, betreibst und optimierst du sichere Datenanbindungen, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen und unterstützt bei Tests, Qualitätssicherung sowie der kontinuierlichen Wartung und Weiterentwicklung
 Dein Profil:
 Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene IT-Berufsausbildung mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung mit
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Machine-Learning- und KI-Anwendungen bringst du mit und kennst dich mit der Integration, Validierung, Nachvollziehbarkeit und produktiven Bereitstellung von KI-Modellen aus
 Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC), idealerweise mit Bicep, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Technologien, zeichnen dich aus
 Du bringst praktische Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Cloud-Plattformen wie Microsoft Azure oder AWS mit, vorzugsweise im Bereich Datenverarbeitung, Datenanalyse oder Künstliche Intelligenz
 Mit modernen KI-Technologien und Frameworks wie Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, LiteLLM oder vergleichbaren Frameworks für KI-Agenten bist du vertraut
 Du hast Erfahrung im Umgang mit Datenbanken und Datenplattformen, insbesondere MySQL, NoSQL-Technologien und Vektordatenbanken, sowie mit Architekturen zur Integration großer Datenmengen
 Fundierte Kenntnisse in DevOps und Technologien wie GitLab CI / CD, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux und Bash sowie in Monitoring-Lösungen (z. B. Grafana, Prometheus) und agilen Methoden wie Kanban
 Analytisches Denkvermögen, eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Lernbereitschaft und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse zeichnen dich aus. Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, im Bereich generativer KI technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen, runden dein Profil ab
 Du hast Freude daran, den direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen mit der praktischen Arbeit an modernen Technologien zu verbinden. Ob bei der technischen Beratung, der Entwicklung von Datenintegrationen oder der Einführung generativer KI-Lösungen: Du begeisterst dich dafür, komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen und innovative KI-Technologien in einen konkreten Mehrwert für unsere Kund und den DB-Konzern zu verwandeln.

Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.
Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

 Fundierte Programmierkenntnisse in Python sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code (IaC), idealerweise mit Bicep, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Technologien, zeichnen dich aus
