Who We Are
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role
 You will sit at the centre of the Optics Cluster in our Test Department, with a scope that crosses cluster boundaries. A sensing subsystem is not only an optics problem. It sits where optics, electronics, embedded software, and mechanical integration meet.
Integration decides whether sensor data can be trusted. An EO camera that is perfectly focused but misaligned with the LiDAR produces unsafe data. A LWIR sensor that passes standalone characterisation can still fail beside a hot avionics bay. The airframe tells a different story from the bench.
You will therefore do more than execute tests. You will act as the sensing system architect for test, and you will:
 Turn sensing subsystem requirements into structured test cases and test equipment concepts. 
 Specify and commission the optical, electrical, and mechanical ground support equipment (OGSE, EGSE, and MGSE) that each modality needs. 
 Serve as the department's technical authority on sensor synchronisation, calibration, and multimodal data quality. 
 The day-to-day
 Prototype testing: Characterise new sensors and integrated sensing subsystems during development. Turn requirements, such as performance at a given speed, temperature or altitude, into test plans. Design, build, and run the lab setups that show whether the sensor meets them. 
 Integration support: Help decide how cameras and other sensors fit each new platform, including mounting angles, focus, field of view, and protective window. 
 Production support: Define and run the acceptance test procedures that every production unit must pass before shipment. 
 Supplier evaluation: Assess new sensor suppliers and components against technical requirements before we commit to procurement. 
 In-service root cause analysis: Investigate sensing failures in products already flying, in the field or from reports. Reproduce the fault, fix it, and give structured findings to the design and manufacturing teams. 
 You should apply if you
 Must have skills:
 Have hands-on experience testing optical cameras or imaging systems in a lab, in industry or in applied research. 
 Have designed and built your own test setups, not only run existing procedures. 
 Can turn specifications into test cases with clear pass or fail criteria. 
 Troubleshoot hardware in a structured, practical way. 
 Hold a degree in engineering, physics, or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience. 
 Work professionally in English. 
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to Have
 Experience with radar or LiDAR sensors. This is a strong plus. 
 Experience with thermal (LWIR) cameras. 
 Familiarity with sensor fusion, synchronisation, or camera calibration. 
 Programming skills, such as Python or MATLAB, for test automation and data analysis. 
 Experience with environmental testing, including temperature and vibration. 
 A background in aerospace, defence, or another regulated hardware field. 
 German language skills. 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation 
 Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance 
 Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health) 
 Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances 
 Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work 
 A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

Member of Technical Staff — Platform Engineering 
 Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We're building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen.
 You’ll build the platform that brings our research into production, making Remanence easy to deploy and operate in customer clouds and on-premises.
 What you'll work on 
 Build deployment tooling for our training, evaluation and inference systems.
 Automate installations, upgrades and rollbacks.
 Make deployments work within customers’ security and access requirements.
 Build monitoring and diagnostics for systems we cannot access directly.
 Work with researchers on sandboxing and distributed workload orchestration.
 Support customer deployments and turn recurring needs into reusable tooling.
 Relevant technologies 
 Deployment and automation: Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD or Flux
 Infrastructure and security: Linux, Docker, networking, access controls, secrets management
 Backend and distributed systems: Python or Go, Ray, Slurm, distributed object storage, PostgreSQL
 Releases and monitoring: GitHub Actions, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
 Required: Production experience with Kubernetes and Terraform 
 About you 
 You have strong software engineering and systems fundamentals. You’ve used Kubernetes and Terraform in production. You’re comfortable debugging applications, infrastructure and networks. You make sound engineering decisions and care about reliability.
Experience with ML infrastructure or enterprise deployments is a plus. We welcome both specialists and fast-learning generalists.
 What we offer 
 Competitive compensation and equity.
 A fast-paced environment combining frontier research with impactful real-world applications.
 Visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates joining us in Paris or London.
 A flexible hybrid setup, with a preference for working together in person.

Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 About the role
 BLP only works when it talks to our customers' ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for our customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You'll take ownership of integrations across ERPs such as Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS and abas, and help us connect to the next one.
   What you’ll do
 Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, OData, direct DB access and file transfers.
 Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.
 Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.
 Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, documentation and driving improvements to ensure market fit, reliability and efficient installation.
 Enable technical project managers and integration specialists to consult on, install and configure existing integrations.
   What you'll bring
 Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go fast, that works for us.
 Hands-on integration experience with at least one ERP system (e.g., SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Infor, IFS, ABAS or similar), ideally more than one. You have built or maintained native interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.
 A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.
 Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.
 Nice to have: 
 Experience writing production code in Go.
 Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.
 A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in ERP systems: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.
 Experience with both cloud and on-premise ERP environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access or API rate limits in cloud ERPs).
 Why BLP 
 Real impact: your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.
 Breadth: Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.
 Growth: fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.
 Team: regular team events.
 Practical information 
 Location: We have an office in Zurich, London, Munich and Cologne, hybrid with 3+ office days per week in those locations or remotely from anywhere in Europe.
 If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.
 Employment: full-time, permanent.

Who we are 
 Apollo , a Skyward Group company, is an innovation-inspired insurance platform operating at Lloyd’s of London, delivering data-driven and creative solutions across a broad range of risks.
Our name reflects our origins. Inspired by one of our founding investors, Neil Armstrong, the first person to walk on the moon, the business was built with the same pioneering mindset. Alongside Jim Hays, Neil set out to create a different kind of Lloyd’s platform, focused, agile and built around people.
Since launch in 2009, we have grown into a diversified insurance group offering products across Property, Casualty, Marine, Energy and Transportation, Specialty and Reinsurance, alongside Smart Follow and digital and embedded risk programmes. Our experience and unique ecosystem give Platform Partners the best chance of success, from navigating the Lloyd’s new entrant process through to the delivery of their long-term strategy.
With a team of more than 300 professionals, we continue to grow with purpose, combining underwriting excellence, innovation and collaboration to enable a more resilient and sustainable world.
 Your Role 
 We are growing how we use AI across underwriting, operations and colleague-facing products and are looking for an AI Engineer to join our Digital Solutions team.
 This is a hands-on software engineering role where you will build AI-enabled applications and services that solve real business problems. You will take defined features from an initial idea through design, development and testing into production, then remain accountable for how they perform and improve in live use.
 You will have room to make day-to-day technical decisions and independently own your work, while collaborating with Product, Engineering, Data and other technical specialists where needed.
 What you'll do 
 Build and integrate AI-enabled applications, services and features using approved models, APIs and enterprise data.
 Work with Product colleagues to understand the problem first, then determine where AI can genuinely deliver a useful outcome.
 Apply techniques such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), assistants and agents, prompt and context engineering, workflow orchestration and safe tool or function calling where appropriate.
 Write clean, maintainable and testable code supported by automated testing and AI evaluation.
 Evaluate AI behaviour including effectiveness, groundedness, reliability, safety, performance and cost.
 Build appropriate guardrails, access controls and human oversight into the solutions you develop.
 Take your work through deployment into production, monitoring performance, diagnosing issues and improving reliability based on live operational evidence.
 Manage changes to prompts, retrieval configurations, models and application components safely.
 Contribute to code reviews, technical discussions and reusable AI engineering practices across the team.
 What we are looking for 
 Strong software engineering skills using Python, C# or a comparable language, including maintainable code, automated testing, APIs and CI/CD.
 Evidence of taking an application, service or significant feature from idea through development and deployment into production, with responsibility for supporting and improving it afterwards.
 Hands-on experience building applications using large language models and APIs, with practical depth in areas such as RAG, prompt and context engineering, orchestration or tool calling.
 An understanding of retrieval, embeddings and vector search, alongside a systematic approach to evaluating how AI applications behave.
 Experience troubleshooting applications or services in production and an understanding of reliability, data access, privacy and security considerations.
 The ability to independently own a defined feature or component and make sound technical decisions within established engineering standards.
 A pragmatic, product-minded approach. You will be interested in solving the underlying business problem rather than using AI for its own sake.
 Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, vector databases, AI observability or similar technologies would be beneficial, but you do not need experience across every area.
 Experience applying AI within financial services, insurance or another regulated environment would also be beneficial.
 What you’ll get in return
 We offer a competitive and thoughtfully designed reward package that reflects the value of our people. This includes a fair and attractive salary, discretionary bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package - including 31 days’ annual leave, a non-contributory pension and private medical insurance.
 Our commitment to inclusion
 At Apollo, people are at the heart of everything we do. We are a diverse, growing team of empowered experts who bring collaboration, innovation and data-driven thinking to every relationship and every risk.
We believe diversity and inclusion go far beyond targets. They are essential to understanding the global communities we serve and to making better decisions. That’s why we are committed to developing diverse talent at every level and creating an environment where different perspectives are genuinely valued, supported and celebrated.
We also run a programme of events, training and initiatives designed to recognise both the challenges and opportunities that come with building an inclusive workplace.
 Hybrid & flexible working
 Flexible and hybrid working are fully embraced at Apollo. We do not believe in presenteeism. Instead, we trust our people to work in ways that allow them to perform at their best, balancing professional responsibilities with personal commitments.
 Supporting your application
 Apollo is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment experience where every candidate feels supported and able to perform at their best.
 To help us do this, we invite you to complete a confidential ClearTalents profile. It takes just a few minutes and allows you to share any adjustments that may support you during the recruitment process.
 Your information remains private, and the recruitment team is only notified if an adjustment is requested. Please register to create your profile here: ClearTalents

 Qualifikation 
 Das passt zu dir, wenn:
 ✅ Du in Python produktiven Code schreiben kannst und in C/C++ tief genug bist, um auf Embedded-Layer-Bugs einzusteigen

About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
 Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
 About the role 
 Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.
 We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:
 Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers) 
 Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more
 Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.
 Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.
 Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams) 
 Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.
 Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.
 Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.
 In both teams you will:
 Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.
 Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.
 Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.
 Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.
 Requirements 
 We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:
 Expertise in Python.
 A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.
 Experience with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure, including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions and data structures.
 Strong test design and security fundamentals.
 Care and attention to detail when changing live, business-critical systems, and the ability to learn a large existing codebase quickly.
 Comfort with ambiguity: working out what should be built, and prioritising among competing signals.
 Bonus:
 Experience with authentication, authorization or permissioning (OAuth, SSO/SCIM, RBAC or similar).
 Experience with Kubernetes.
 Experience building internal platforms or services used by other engineering teams.
 Location 
 Our team is based across the UK, EU and US, and this is our main focus. We are flexible for exceptional candidates elsewhere. You can work remotely, or from our offices in Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco and Warsaw.

## Job Description: 
Drive the development of AI models for Intel XeSS and related AI-based graphics technologies for Client Graphics, with direct impact across XeSS Super Resolution, XeSS Frame Generation, neural rendering, and next-generation AI rendering capabilities. You will contribute to technical direction and drive execution across research, SW, HW architecture, validation, and ecosystem teams to bring new technologies from concept to product.
This is an end-to-end technical role spanning model design, datasets, training, visual quality, performance optimization, and product integration. You will help shape how modern AI model architectures are adapted for the quality, performance, and latency constraints of real-time graphics.
## Key Responsibilities:
- Drive the development of AI models for XeSS and next-generation neural rendering capabilities, from early exploration through product delivery.
- Design, train, and evaluate AI models for super resolution, frame generation, neural rendering, and related real-time graphics workloads.
- Develop training methods, loss functions, and evaluation approaches that improve visual quality, temporal stability, robustness, and model efficiency.
- Define dataset requirements and work with data and infrastructure teams to improve training coverage, reference quality, and data pipelines.
- Analyze visual quality and model failure cases, and drive improvements across models, training data, model inputs, and product integration.
- Optimize AI models for real-time execution on Intel GPUs, balancing visual quality, latency, memory and compute costs.
- Collaborate with SW, HW architecture, validation, and ecosystem teams to integrate, validate, and deliver product-ready technologies.
- Evaluate emerging AI architectures and techniques, and help define the technical direction for future XeSS and AI graphics capabilities.
## **Qualifications:**
## Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
- 8+ years of relevant industry experience developing AI/ML technologies for graphics, imaging, video, or related areas, including experience delivering production-quality solutions.
- Strong expertise in AI/ML for real-time graphics, imaging, or video, such as super resolution, frame generation, denoising, reconstruction, optical flow, or related AI rendering workloads.
- Experience developing AI technologies from research through productization, with experience across model architecture, datasets, training, evaluation, optimization, and deployment.
- Strong programming skills in Python and experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
- Strong understanding of GPU architecture, performance, memory systems, latency, and hardware-aware optimization.
- Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and collaborate across cross-functional teams spanning research, SW, and HW.
## Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience developing AI upscaling, frame generation, neural rendering, or adjacent AI-based graphics technologies.
- Good understanding of modern neural network architectures, such as convolutional networks, Vision Transformers, diffusion models, and related architectures.
- Experience with high-performance GPU compute, inference kernels, or production AI deployment.
- Experience with dataset capture, processing, and training infrastructure for graphics AI models.
- Experience productizing AI technologies through SDKs, APIs, or cross-platform SW.
- Experience with C++ and real-time graphics APIs or shader programming, such as Direct3D, Vulkan, HLSL, or GLSL.
- Experience influencing future GPU or AI accelerator features based on AI workload analysis.

About Niantic Spatial 
 We are building for the >80% of economic activity that happens beyond the reach of screens. AI has learned from the text, images and video online, but it still lacks an accurate understanding of physical space.
 That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.
 In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.
 Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.
 About the Role 
 Niantic Spatial makes the physical world computable, helping people and machines collaborate safely by aligning how they understand reality. One of the fundamental problems we're helping autonomy teams and engineers overcome is the sim-to-real gap for visual-spatial understanding. We're applying our team's decades of experience encoding the world precisely as it is at Google Maps, Google Earth, and Niantic Labs to build the scalable real-to-sim stack for embodied AI.
 Niantic Spatial's R&D Team in London is seeking a Research Scientist to push the frontiers of Spatial AI, advancing our Large Geospatial Model as a dedicated member of the Embodied AI group. You will invent and develop algorithms and systems that sit at the cross-section of computer vision, machine learning, AI, graphics, and robotics.
 We're passionate about discovery, so we're looking for scientists who want to learn, publish, teach, and deploy every new invention.
 What You'll Do

 Advance Real-to-Sim Pipelines - Advance real-to-sim pipelines connecting real-world observations, 3D reconstruction, simulation, and robotic policy learning.
 Solve Emerging Spatial Problems - Solve emerging problems that relate to spatial intelligence, 3D scene representation, training data, model efficiency, and interactive systems.
 Take Capabilities Through to Evidence - Take new capabilities through to evidence: what changed for the policy, not only what changed in the reconstruction.
 Build Prototypes - Build proof of concept prototypes, initially for internal use, where some will need to run at production scale on customer data.
 Collaborate Across Research and Product - Collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, and product partners to bring novel models to production.
 Publish Your Work - Publish and present your work.
 What You'll Bring

 Substantial expertise in robotics or embodied AI, including experience in sim-to-real transfer, domain randomization, policy evaluation, and simulation-based learning.
 Deep experience with 3D scene representations: Gaussian splatting, neural fields, meshes, point clouds, or implicit representations.

 In a technically exciting and fast-evolving environment, you will help us build digital trust products for organizations.  As a Fullstack DevOps Engineer, you will design, build, and operate backend services, APIs, cloud infrastructure, databases, and selected frontend capabilities for these products.  Build and operate backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, and Spring Boot.
 Design secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for eID, verification, onboarding, KYB, and compliance-related products.
 Work with AWS services, databases, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure automation.

 Help the team build market-driven products that create real value, not just technical functionality.

 Solid experience building services with Spring Boot.
 Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and distributed backend systems.
 Practical experience with AWS cloud services.
 Good knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modelling, and query performance.
 Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, Git-based workflows, and production operations.
 Basic frontend experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern framework such as Vue.js , React, or Angular.
 Ability to work in an agile, international, and cross-functional DevOps team.
 Excellent written and spoken English.
Nice-to-haves:

 Experience with event-driven architectures, messaging, queues, or asynchronous processing. 
 Experience with observability tooling, logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting. 
 Experience with frontend architecture, design systems, accessibility, or component libraries. 
 Strong communication skills, pragmatic thinking, and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Growth at Private Equity Insights
 The world’s most demanding investors are busy managing trillions, and ignore anything average. Are you excited by the challenge of making them act?
 Are you looking to work in an exceptional entrepreneurial team with ambitious, motivated and extremely driven people? And do you want real ownership from your first week? If so, now is the time to apply for the Growth role at Private Equity Insights.
 The mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors.
 You will work in sprints and get fast execution under your skin. AI has completely changed the game: You will learn to deploy it to outperform a marketing team of 20+ people, while also learning the fundamentals of copywriting that makes elite investors act, get it to the right investor at a meaningful frequency and deploy what works across every marketing channel.
 If you want an ambitious mission, real ownership and the fastest learning curve of your career: apply.
 Why Private Equity Insights 
 Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with 1m PE professionals, delivering impact through 12 global PE conferences with thousands of the world’s best investors and operators such as Blackstone, BlackRock, Apollo, Carlyle, CVC, KKR, and many more.
 Private Equity Insights is part of United Media ( https://www.united-media.com/ ) which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 5 media companies and exited 1.
 What we offer you 
 Master the highest bar in the world. Our audience is the world's most demanding investors. They ignore anything average. If your work can make them act, you can make anyone act.
 Unlimited growth potential. You will get responsibility before you feel ready. That is how you grow fast. We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally. You can expect coaching and development from leaders, peers and experts.
 Skills that compound for life. Fast execution, copywriting, pricing, conversion optimisation, structured problem solving, and the ability to create impact anywhere in the business at scale.
 Ownership from the very start. You own outcomes, not tasks. We agree the goal, and you find the way.
 Travel opportunity. You will be joining our 10+ conferences.
 What you will do 
 Responsibilities in this job will vary, however, feed into the mission: build the world's largest network for private equity investors. They will be mostly centered around the following:
 Build the audience. Identify, target, and convert every fund into our community, and make sure each one receives the right message, at the right time, and never one too many.
 Own marketing channels that drive revenue. Through existing and new marketing channels, you execute activities that ultimately will drive revenue
 Write copy that persuades. Every email, landing page and post. Become the best copywriter and leverage it at scale with AI.
 Sprint, test, implement. Measure the impact of all experiments you run, test offers, copy, prices and pages until the numbers move.
 Build systems, not one-offs. Anything you do twice becomes a playbook or an AI workflow, so the next win takes less effort than the last.
 Do whatever it takes to win. Some days that means designing an AI workflow. Some days it means checking investors in at the registration desk at 7am. Nobody here is too good for the work that deliver value for investors and fund managers.
 What we expect from you 
 1 to 3 years of experience
 Min. a bachelor or master degree with great results
 A UK work permit. We do not sponsor visas.
 Strong work ethic with a sense of urgency
 Exceptional drive and desire to be the best at what you do
 Proactive approach and sense of ownership/responsibility of everything you do
 A humble approach and share our passion for building companies and developing people
 Interested in continuous learning and proactively searching for ways to optimise
 Practical details 
 Full-time, in person from our London office (WeWork), 5 days a week. Expect to travel for work about 20 days a year. The start date is flexible.

## Job Description:
Do what you love as a Software Engineer!
As part of our multi-national team, you will be designing, developing, and maintaining efficient and reliable C++ code for a sophisticated software environment in the space domain. The position includes developing software models for satellite subsystems as well as contributing to the simulation infrastructure libraries shared between several missions. As member of a team with excellent expertise in both software development and space, you will get the opportunity to develop your career.
Help us to identify bottlenecks as well as bugs, and devise solutions to these problems by assuring the functionality of the systems. You will help maintaining the code quality, organization, and automation. You will translate the customer needs into delivered features, and become proficient in estimating and defining your future tasks.
Show us what you have as a C++ Developer!
You have proficiency in C/C++, with fair knowledge of the corresponding language specifications and with shown experience. You know how to use the standard template library and its containers. You know object orientation, and can draw and understand class diagrams in UML.
You are familiar with development tools such as debuggers, profilers, and tracing utilities. You are excellent at problem solving, with a logical and pragmatic demeanour.
Do you want us to invest in you?
## Responsibilitites / Duties
- Design, develop, document and test software in C++ that you and your company can be proud of.
- Show everyone what you are capable of, disseminating knowledge and learn with others; praising openly successes of your colleagues and receive praise for your own successes.
- Grow yourself, grow the company and be rewarded as a technical specialist
- No need to get ‘manager’ in the job title and only develop stuff in Microsoft Office
## Qualifications/Experience
- Degree educated SW Engineer
- Some experience in working in a team as working student or staff member
## Essential Skills
- C++ programming language
- Object oriented programming and design using UML
- Proficiency in spoken and written English
## Desirable Skills
Experience with more sophisticated elements of software development would be an asset:
- Linux command line, Source Code Control System (Git), Maven
- Debugging of code, static and dynamic code analysis
- Experience in continuous integration processes and tools
- Knowledge of automated testing using CppUnit or similar
- JavaScript and Java programming languages
A background in space market and its applicable standards would help further:
- SMP2 or ECSS SMP standard, and the SIMULUS suite
- Spacecraft Operations including ECSS-E-70 (Packet Utilisation Standard)
- Spacecraft Database, e.g. expressed as SCOS MIB or EGS-CC CDM

Vervollständigt wird unser Know-How durch Teams aus den Bereichen Diagnose, Testing, Machine Datamanagement sowie unseren Expert:innen für Architektur und AI, ebenso wie durch übergreifende Support Bereiche. Jeden Tag arbeiten wir daran, Landwirtschaft noch effizienter zu gestalten.
 Präzision, die Landwirtschaft bewegt

 Entwicklung innovativer Systemlösungen für GPS-gestütztes Lenken, Precision Farming und ISOBUS-Anwendungen

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.
 What is the role about 
 As a fast paced, highly targeted and highly regulated company, security is more important here than most other companies. That means your impact can be much more material, this role is about working with our brothers and sisters in product and engineering and building security through collaboration. It’s about being an engineer who knows how to use automation and tooling to get more done at pace and to scale security’s impact.
 The role includes ‘whole of product’ security - Application, architecture and infrastructure. You’ll understand deeply the threats posed to us by threat actors and where to focus our attention, you’ll be the kind of person who enjoys building long lasting relationships, making impact by really moving the needle and scaling through automation so you are always focussed on the highest value work.
 How will you make an impact 
 Threat modelling: Taking an attackers lens on what’s being built and understanding how it could be abused/targeted and being able to bring others on the journey through clear communication.
 Pen testing/Red teaming/Vuln discovery: Being the threat actor but with a whitebox approach, thinking about what tools can you build to help scale these processes. Thinking about how we bring in more data to find the right issues and surface them with appropriate prioritisation.
 Communication and relationships: Bringing teams on side by working together with the attackers lens, collaboratively designing best of breed security controls that mitigate threads and support the business and our customers by making them as slick as possible.
 Going deep on existing MO’s and industry attack knowledge : Understanding deeply the attackers, their motivations and evolving techniques, performing evaluations of our controls to ensure they hold up, continuously iterating and educating.
 How will you be successful? 
 Backend/frontend development background with a transition into security engineering
 5+ years of experience in secure software development and AppSec
 Demonstrable record of delivering real world security improvements
 Deep experience of scaling security through automation including AI and slick processes
 Experience with Kubernetes, containers and CI/CD
 Strong AWS and/or GCP experience
 Strong understanding of AuthN/AuthZ, API security, AI Security and OWASP Top 10
 Experience with tools such as Burp, Wiz, Snyk, Semgrep, Bug bounty and SAST platforms
 Experience in fintech, payments, crypto or other regulated industries is a big plus
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think like an attacker to anticipate and prevent security issues
 Strong Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Bug Bounty participation/Hall of fame/CVE IDs are a big plus

About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.
 When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.
 The work combines research and production engineering:
 The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers .
 The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.
 Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.
 Key responsibilities
 Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals
 Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour
 Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies
 Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find
 Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection
 Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest
 Minimum qualifications
 Ability to organise and prioritise several parallel streams of work, and to communicate clearly with the teams that work affects
 Ability to critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents
 Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers
 Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly
 Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection
 Experience running low-latency, high-availability services that other systems depend on, including being on call for them
 Experience fine-tuning language models, or working with probes and other methods that read model internals
 Experience with LLM inference or serving infrastructure, or with integrating new components into training infrastructure
 Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response
 Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary: £375,000 — £640,000 GBP Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.  Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

 The Product 
 In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

 Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interaction contracts, while remaining flexible as the system evolves
 Define and implement observability primitives, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals across offline and nearline pipelines
 Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations when business needs require it
 Collaborate with runtime and ML teams to ensure indexing outputs meet retrieval and ranking requirements
 Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and data processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals

 Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability

 Systems-thinking mindset and ability to reason about end-to-end data flows

In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.
 Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we're proud of. We're committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
 The Role
 You'll own the quality of the firmware and embedded systems across our physical product portfolio. That means making sure every firmware release is tested, reliable, and ready for the field, and that defects are caught before they reach a client.
 This is a senior, hands-on role. You understand electronics and embedded systems well enough to reproduce and diagnose issues yourself, read a schematic, and build your own test kits and jigs. You don't wait for an engineer to set things up for you. You run your area independently.
 Over the past year, we've built a validation framework that changed how we release firmware. We now ship on evidence instead of gut feel: structured test cycles across our product generations, tracked defects across release candidates, formal release reviews, and controlled rollouts to the fleet. Your first job is to own that framework and keep it strong.
 Your bigger job is to take it further. Today, testing mostly happens once a release is nearly done. We want to catch risk earlier, inside the firmware stage-gate process, through integration testing, corner cases, and tests at the edges of the operating envelope. You'll move firmware QA from reacting to preventing.
 What You'll Do
 Embedded & Firmware Testing
 Own test strategy and execution for firmware and embedded systems across our physical products.
 Reproduce field and development issues independently, using your electrical and embedded understanding.
 Develop diagnostic and validation methods for firmware features, aligned with our stage-gate process.
 Define and run regression testing ahead of every firmware release.
 Test at the system-integration and interface level, including the edges of the operating envelope where real risk sits.
 Reliability & Field Quality
 Support containment and root-cause analysis for firmware and embedded field issues.
 Feed field learnings back into the test suite. Every field issue is a missing test.
 Contribute embedded input to DFMEA and PFMEA and to our stage-gate quality gates.
 What You Bring
 Experience building embedded test capability from an early stage, a background that bridges electronics and firmware, or exposure to a stage-gate release process for embedded products sets you apart.
 6+ years in embedded or Firmware QA 
 A strong electrical and embedded background: you read schematics, understand PCB and hardware behavior, and reproduce embedded issues on your own.
 Firmware testing experience across diagnostics, validation, and regression.
 A hands-on, self-sufficient approach: you build your own test kits, jigs, and test environments.
 Experience with system-level integration testing for a hardware and firmware product.
 A pragmatic, risk-weighted mindset: you test in proportion to the risk, not for coverage's sake.
 Comfort in a lean, fast-moving team where you own your area, and the habit of using AI tools every day.
 Why Aquablu?
 You'll build the foundation that lets quality scale at Aquablu, with real ownership from day one and a direct line to our firmware and digital engineering teams.

AI answers are only as trustworthy as the information behind them. Perplexity grounds its answers in fresh, real-world sources, and the index is what makes that possible. We're looking for an engineer to work on the indexing and data processing layer of Perplexity's Search Crawler. You'll build systems that ingest, process, and organize large volumes of crawled content into efficient, queryable structures, working primarily on offline and nearline pipelines that keep data fresh, complete, and accessible to downstream retrieval. Throughput, scalability, and correctness are critical across datasets that change continuously.
 Responsibilities 
 Design, implement, and operate large-scale indexing systems and data pipelines at the core of Perplexity's search infrastructure.

 Work on storage formats, compaction, and update mechanisms that keep data accessible and current.
 Keep pipelines reliable and predictable under high-throughput conditions. 
 Build well-tested components with clear responsibilities and interface contracts that stay flexible as the system evolves.
 Define and implement observability across offline and near line pipelines, including structured logs, metrics, and data quality signals.
 Monitor throughput, resource usage, and cost, and drive optimisations as business needs change.
 Partner with retrieval, ranking, and ML teams to make sure indexing outputs meet their requirements.
 Enable safe experimentation on indexing strategies and processing logic through controlled rollouts and clearly defined quality signals.
 Qualifications 
 5+ years of experience building production backend or data infrastructure systems.
 Strong programming experience in Go, C++, or Rust.
 Experience with high-throughput data processing systems and very large datasets.
 Experience building or operating databases, storage systems, data planes, or indexing pipelines.
 Strong understanding of distributed systems, fault tolerance, consistency, and scalability.
 Experience running production systems and handling operational incidents.
 A systems-thinking mindset and the ability to reason about end-to-end data flows.

 Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter - Experte für vertrauenswürdige KI (all genders)
 Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ( www.fraunhofer.de ) ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.
 Am Fraunhofer IAIS erforschen und entwickeln rund 360 Mitarbeitende individuelle Lösungen zur Integration und Analyse von Daten für unsere Fördergeber*innen und unsere Kund*innen aus der Wirtschaft. Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning, Big Data, Multimedia Content Analytics, Information Integration sowie Unternehmensmodellierung und -analyse sind die inhaltlichen Schwerpunkte unserer Arbeiten.
 In der Abteilung AI Assurance and Assessments (AAA) operationalisieren wir KI-Vertrauenswürdigkeit entlang von drei Schritten:
 Wir analysieren Anforderungen an KI-Systeme aus Gesetzen und Standards.
 Wir setzen diese Anforderungen um, indem wir technische Absicherungsmethoden für KI-Systeme entwickeln und diese auf organisatorischer Ebene durch effektive KI-Governance Mechanismen komplettieren.
 Wir entwickeln Prüfkriterien und Testverfahren für KI-Systeme und forschen zu der Frage, wie sich solche Prüfungen und Tests automatisieren lassen.
 Hierbei beschäftigen uns Fragestellungen wie: Wie lassen sich a priori inkommensurable KI-Risiken, etwa die Verletzung von Persönlichkeitsrechten und Safety-Risiken zu einem Gesamtrisiko aggregieren? Wie lassen sich die Unsicherheiten von Transformer-Modellen messen? Welche Controls in KI-Managementsystemen operationalisieren den AI Act? Wie lassen sich KI-Prüfworkflows automatisieren? Was sind die besten Redteaming Ansätze, um die Safeguards von LLMs zu testen? Wie lassen sich KI-Agenten im Betrieb absichern?
 Bei Fraunhofer IAIS zu arbeiten, heißt unternehmerisches Denken mit Spitzenforschung zu verbinden: Unsere Abteilung AAA hat weltweit Kunden, die von großen Technologiekonzernen bis hin zu Start-ups reichen. Auch viele Behörden zählen zu unseren Auftraggebern. Gleichzeitig entstehen aus unserer Forschung wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Doktorarbeiten. Unser interdisziplinäres Team hat Abschlüsse in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Rechtswissenschaften und Psychologie und freut sich auf Sie!  
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Übersetzung von regulatorischen Vorgaben, wie etwa der KI-Verordnung, in technische Anforderungen an KI-Systeme
 Konzeption und Entwicklung von technischen Lösungen zur Absicherung von KI-Systemen
 Konzeption und Entwicklung von KI-Governance Frameworks
 Konzeption und Durchführung von KI-Prüfungen für konkrete Use Cases
 Entwicklung von Methoden zur Messung und Quantifizierung von Unsicherheiten in KI-Modellen (z. B. Transformer-Architekturen)
 Durchführung von Redteaming- und Stresstests zur Absicherung von LLMs und KI-Agenten im produktiven Einsatz
 Automatisierung von KI-Prüf- und Testworkflows
 Beratung von Kund*innen aus Wirtschaft und öffentlicher Verwaltung zur regulatorischen Einordnung und Absicherung ihrer KI-Systeme
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master, Diplom) der Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik mit sehr gutem Abschluss an einer Universität mit internationalem Renommee, gerne mit Promotion. Bei guter Passung zu einem der oben genannten Themen kommen auch andere Abschlüsse (z.B. Rechtswissenschaften, Psychologie) in Betracht
 Sehr gute Vorkenntnisse in den Bereichen Maschinelles Lernen, Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und Agentische KI
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse zu
 Programmierung (insb. Python und ML-Frameworks with pytorch und tensorflow) und technischer Implementierung (Docker/Podman und Containerisierung, Azure, AWS oder andere Cloudprovider, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD) und im Umgang mit Agent Frameworks/Harnesses (z.B. ClaudeCode, OpenAI Codex oder LangGraph) oder 
 KI-Regulierung und Standardisierung (KI-Recht, insb. AI Act, internationale Standardisierung bei ISO, IEC und ITU, europäische Standardisierung bei CEN, CENELEC, ETSI, harmonisierte Normen)
 Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude an abstraktem Denken
 Hohe Belastbarkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, sich schnell in neue Sachverhalte einzuarbeiten
 Freude daran, komplizierte technische Zusammenhänge für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufzubereiten
 Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und Hands-on Mentalität
 Strukturiertes Arbeiten und professionelles Auftreten
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Englischkenntnisse (beides mind. auf Niveau C1)
 Bitte gehen Sie in ihrem Anschreiben darauf ein, welche Themenschwerpunkte der Abteilung AAA Sie besonders interessieren, welche Vorerfahrungen Sie hierfür mitbringen, was Sie bei Fraunhofer IAIS erreichen möchten und warum wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und unternehmerisches Talent in ihrer Person vereint sind.
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Wir bieten Ihnen vielfältige Angebote für Ihre persönliche Weiterbildung in den Bereichen Führung, Kommunikation, Projektmanagement, Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, Gesundheit, Kultur und Sport. Die Förderung der Chancengerechtigkeit unserer Mitarbeitenden ist ein wichtiges Ziel von Fraunhofer. Wir fördern die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen in unserem Institut und ermutigen sie nachdrücklich, sich zu bewerben. 
 Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung und Qualifikation bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.
 The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.
 About the Role 
 Most software engineers never see their code tested against reality. At Swarm Aero, that's the baseline.
 We are looking for a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to own multiple initiatives across our customer programs and lead the forward deployed engineers working on them. You will work directly with U.S. government and military customers to understand the mission, decide what our C2 and onboard autonomy software can deliver, and set the technical plan to get it into the field. You will make the feasibility calls, keep everyone involved working from the same plan, and make sure your initiatives are ready for the releases that put new capability in operators' hands.
 This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will still write code, debug systems in the field, and be on site when the work goes live.
   What You'll Do 
 Own multiple initiatives within a customer program, from early requirements through deployment. Turn mission needs into a technical roadmap for each one, and make the feasibility and tradeoff calls across them.
 Lead the forward deployed engineers working on your initiatives by setting technical direction, breaking down the work, and clearing blockers.
 Write and integrate C2 and onboard autonomy software for unmanned air and sea vehicles, and debug it in the field when something breaks.
 Participate in and lead design reviews for your initiatives before work starts.
 Run post-incident reviews after field issues, find the root cause, and put fixes in place so the same problem does not happen again.
 Bring field data and lessons learned back to the core product team.
 Work with partner teams to align on priorities and timelines, gather their feedback, and run internal testing before every deployment.
 Plan how your initiatives fit into each contract release alongside core product work, and make sure they are tested and ready before the release ships.
 Serve as the main technical contact for vehicle and sensor vendors, and lead the integration of their systems with ours.
 Define success criteria with customers for each event, run the readiness review for your initiatives beforehand, and give the go/no-go recommendation.
 Mentor forward deployed engineers and help with technical assessments of potential candidates.
 Support deployments outside normal hours, including on-call response and rotational coverage aligned to mission tempo.
 Travel domestically and internationally (up to 50%) to test sites and customer locations, and lead the team on site.
   This Role Is For You If 
 You have shipped software to the field and want to own a bigger share of the outcome.
 You like making technical calls under pressure and explaining them to people who need a straight answer.
 You enjoy helping other engineers grow while staying hands-on yourself.
 You can turn an ambiguous customer request into a plan a team can execute.
   This Role Is NOT 
 A people management role away from the code
 A program or project management role
 A pilot position or vehicle operator role
 Primarily hands-on hardware work (electronics, wiring, mechanical assembly)
   Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field
 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability
 Experience leading a small team, feature crew, or sub-program through design and delivery
 Experience building and deploying software for unmanned systems (UAS, USVs, or UUVs), including C2 or onboard autonomy
 Experience working directly with government or military customers to turn mission needs into technical requirements
 Experience supporting live exercises, test events, or field deployments
 Experience shipping work as part of larger releases that combine contributions from several teams
 Strong proficiency in at least one systems language (Golang, Rust, or C/C++)

Our Mission
 At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
 We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!
 The Role
 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you own our customer deployments end to end. Our system runs on-prem at industrial facilities, critical infrastructure, and military sites, integrated with the cameras, networks, and robots already in place. You survey the site, plan the deployment, install and integrate the system, tune it to the site's conditions, and hand it over to operators who will rely on it daily.
 You are also the technical face of Laelaps on site. You work with security operators to understand how they actually work and where the bottlenecks are, align with their leadership on what success looks like, and translate what you learn into configuration, code, and product priorities. Early deployments you run alongside the founders; over time you own sites and accounts independently.
 Expect roughly half your time at customer sites in Switzerland and Europe, and the rest in Zurich, turning field lessons into tooling and automation that make each deployment faster than the last. This is an engineering role with a customer in the room, not a support or services role.
 What You'll Work On
 Deployments end-to-end: site surveys, network and hardware planning, installation, camera and VMS integration, commissioning, validation, and handover.
 On-prem infrastructure: install and manage our stack on edge hardware (NVIDIA DGX Spark, Jetson Thor class devices) inside customer networks, often air-gapped or heavily restricted.
 Integrations: connect existing cameras, sensors, VMS platforms, and robots into one coordinated system, and write the glue code where no integration exists yet.
 System tuning: calibrate detection and tracking to each site's terrain, lighting, and threat profile until the system performs in the field as it does in the demo.
 Pilots to production: make POCs succeed technically, because pilots that work become contracts.
 Customer understanding: sit with operators, interview stakeholders from the control room to the leadership floor, and map the real problems and bottlenecks behind the stated requirements.
 Customer trust: train operators, respond fast when something breaks, and be the engineer customers ask for by name.
 The deployment playbook: turn every hard-won lesson into runbooks, tooling, and automation that compound.
 Product feedback: bring real field signal back to the core engineering team and shape the roadmap with it.
 Who We're Looking For
 We are looking for an engineer who runs toward the messy parts, with the EQ to match the IQ. You are as comfortable in a server room or on a windswept perimeter as you are in a terminal, and just as comfortable in a conversation. You can spend a shift with a security operator and earn enough trust that they tell you what actually goes wrong at 3 a.m., then brief a head of security or a site director in their language, not yours. You listen more than you pitch, you read the room, and you switch registers between the guard house and the boardroom without breaking stride. You debug across the whole stack without ceremony: is it the hardware, the network, the driver, the model, or the config? Above all, you take personal ownership of the outcome: the deployment works because you made it work, and the customer trusts us because you earned it.
 Your Background
 3+ years of relevant software, robotics, embedded systems, or systems integration experience.
 A Master’s degree in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Strong Python and hands-on C++ experience. You can read, debug, and extend production code in both.
 Experience deploying and operating software on-prem or at the edge (Docker required; GPU inference experience a strong plus).
 Experience working with sensors and embedded systems, including device interfaces and communications protocols.
 High EQ and experience working directly with end users or customers: you can uncover needs, work across stakeholders, and communicate technical issues clearly.
 Composure in customer-facing technical sessions, including when systems fail and plans need to change.
 Fluent German and/or French, and good English. Our sites and their operators run in German; the team runs in English.
 Willingness to travel regularly to customer sites across Switzerland and Europe, with multi-day on-site stints.
 Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich.
 Citizenship of Switzerland, an EU/EFTA member state, or a NATO member state, and eligibility for security clearance where customer sites require it.
 A valid category B driving license.
 Nice to Have
 Real networking competence: VLANs, firewalls, routing, VPNs, and debugging connectivity in networks you do not control.
 Hands-on comfort with hardware: you have racked servers, flashed devices, crimped a cable, or built systems that touch the physical world. Checking cable connections at 2 a.m. at a client site is second nature while debugging an issue on a customer side.
 Experience with cameras, VMS platforms (Milestone, Genetec, or similar), ONVIF/RTSP, or the physical security industry.
 Computer vision or ML deployment experience, especially optimising inference on edge GPUs.
 Robotics experience: ROS2 and Rviz2, robot integration, or fleet operations.
 Experience in defence, government, or other regulated environments.
 French, Italian, or another European language.
 Startup experience, ideally somewhere you were handed a hard problem and a deadline instead of a spec.
 What We Offer
 Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.
 Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.
 Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.
 Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.
 Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package
 Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.
